name: troll_opened_back_exit
description: Set to 1 once the player has gone through the Exit in the southern part of the Troll Stronghold jail. Set to 0 otherwise. This appears to be permanent. There does not seem to be any visible change after doing so.

name: pyre_loc
description: Sets to a number between 1 and 24 inclusive to identify the funeral pyre being used by the player. The varbit resets to 0 if the pyre log or pyre logs with remains despawns or is lit. The index of the positions of the Funeral Pyre begins from the north-western pyres in Mort'ton, west of the General Store. The pyres increment counter clock-wise (ie. North - 1, West - 2, South - 3, East - 4). The next group of pyres (counter clockwise from the previous group of pyres) will continue from where the previous index stopped (i.e North - 5, West - 6, and so on).

name: temple_resources
description: This counter tracks the resources in the Shades of Mort'ton (minigame) temple more precisely than the percentage shown in the interface. ==Values== Limits: *Temple cannot be repaired if the resources fall under 100. The user is prompted to increase their materials resource pool. *More resources cannot be added if this value exceeds 15000. Attempting to do so prompts a game message . Changes tested at 99 Crafting: *Adding 1x Limestone brick, 5x Swamp paste, and 1x of Timber beam or Plank increases resources by 800. *Repairing the temple with Flamtaer hammer but without Flamtaer bracelet reduces resources by a random value between 7 to 69 (7 appears to be significantly more common than rest). *Repairing with any other combination of with or without Flamtaer hammer and Flamtaer bracelet reduces resources by a random value between 7 to 49 (7 appears to be significantly more common than rest).

name: stamina_active
description: Set to 1 while run depletion-slowing (stamina potion or ring of endurance) is active.

name: rune_pouch_type_1
description: The type of rune in rune pouch slot 1, stored as an enum value. Amount defined in RS:Varbit/1624. ==Values==

name: horrorquest
description: This is the main var that tracks the progress in Horror from the Deep. ==Values== ;0 Default state, quest has not been started. ;1 Once clicking through the dialogue selection to officially start the quest. ;2 After Larissa tells the player they must go inside to find Jossik. Both sides of the broken bridge must be repaired and the player must have the lighthouse key or already unlocked the Lighthouse front door. ;3 Immediately after talking to Larrissa inside the Lighthouse. ;4 After the lighthouse's torch is fully repaired, requiring swamp tar, a tinderbox, and molten glass to be used on the lighting mechanism. ;5 After the dagannoth is killed and its death animation is over. ;10 After killing the dagannoth mother and its death animation is over. The player is teleported out of the basement intance at the same time.

name: horrordoor
description: Tracks whether the door to the basement is unlocked and switches to 1 after inserting the last required item into the strange wall, so that an air rune, water rune, fire rune, earth rune, valid sword or longsword, and valid arrow have be put into the door, causing something to move within the wall.

name: horrorbridgeleft
description: Tracks whether the player has repaired the western side of the broken bridge leading the to Lighthouse with a plank during Horror from the Deep.

name: horrorbridgeright
description: Tracks whether the player has repaired the eastern side of the broken bridge leading the to Lighthouse with a plank during Horror from the Deep.

name: horroragilitykey
description: Tracks whether Gunnjorn has given the player the Lighthouse key during Horror from the Deep. Set to 1 once the key has entered the player's inventory for the first time.

name: horrorlighthouseentrance
description: Tracks whether the player has unlocked the Lighthouse's front door with the lighthouse key during Horror from the Deep.

name: horrorfire
description: Tracks whether the player has put a fire rune in the strange wall in the Lighthouse basement during Horror from the Deep.

name: horrorwater
description: Tracks whether the player has put a water rune in the strange wall in the Lighthouse basement during Horror from the Deep.

name: horrorearth
description: Tracks whether the player has put an earth rune in the strange wall in the Lighthouse basement during Horror from the Deep.

name: horrorair
description: Tracks whether the player has put an air rune in the strange wall in the Lighthouse basement during Horror from the Deep.

name: horrorsword
description: Tracks whether the player has put a sword or longsword, except for a rusty sword or prop sword, in the strange wall in the Lighthouse basement during Horror from the Deep.

name: horrorarrow
description: Tracks whether the player put an arrow, except for ogre arrows and training arrows, in the strange wall in the Lighthouse basement during Horror from the Deep.

name: horrortar
description: Tracks whether the player has used swamp tar on the lighting mechanism in the Lighthouse during Horror from the Deep.

name: horrorglass
description: Tracks whether the player has used molten glass to repair the torch of the lighting mechanism in the Lighthouse during Horror from the Deep.

name: horrorlight
description: Tracks whether the player has lit the torch with a tinderbox in the lighting mechanism in the Lighthouse during Horror from the Deep.

name: boardgames_myturn
description: Records whether it is currently the player's turn to move in a boardgame in Burthorpe Games Room. ==Values== ; 0 : It is the opponent's turn. ; 1 : It is the player's turn.

name: boardgames_draughts_musttake
description: Records whether the player in Draughts is in a situation where they are forced to capture the opponent's piece in Burthorpe Games Room. ==Values== ; 0 : Default state, player is free to move any piece. ; 1 : The board state forces the player to capture opponent's piece.

name: misc_approval
description: Tracks Miscellania approval rating. The values range from 32 (25% favour) to 127 (100% favour).

name: misc_grantedaudience
description: Set to 1 after the guard confirms you are allowed to enter the throne room on Miscellania before starting Throne of Miscellania.

name: castlewars_catapultx
description: This value is an indicator of the current targeting coordinate offset on the X-axis for the player. When on the Saradomin side, clicking the left arrow will increase the value. When on the Zamorak side, clicking the right arrow will increase the value. 0 is just outside the player's team's castle wall, 30 is towards the centre of the playing field. ==Values== ;0 Default value. Set to 0 every time the targeting menu is opened. Can also be manually set in the menu. ;1–30 Set incrementally by +1 or -1 by adjusting with the arrows on the in-game menu.

name: castlewars_catapultz
description: This value is an indicator of the current targeting coordinate offset on the Y-axis for the player. When on the Saradomin side, clicking the upward arrow will increase the value. When on the Zamorak side, clicking the downward arrow will increase the value. 0 is just outside the player's team's castle wall, 30 is towards the centre of the playing field. ==Values== ;0 Default value. Set to 0 every time the targeting menu is opened. Can also be manually set in the menu. ;1–30 Set incrementally by +1 or -1 by adjusting with the arrows on the in-game menu.

name: marketthief_cake
description: Set to 1 when the player has stolen from any bakery stall in Ardougne, Hosidius market square, or Kourend Castle courtyard. The baker will recognise the player when this is set to 1. Set to 0 after 1,000 consecutive ticks while logged in since the last time one of the stalls as been stolen from.

name: marketthief_silk
description: Set to 1 when the player has stolen from either Silk stall in Ardougne or Kourend Castle courtyard. The Silk Merchant will recognise the player when this is set to 1. Set to 0 after 1,000 consecutive ticks while logged in since silk is last stolen from one of the stalls.

name: marketthief_fur
description: Set to 1 when the player has stolen from the Ardougne Fur Stall. in Ardougne. The fur trader in east ardougne will recognise the player when this is set to 1. Set to 0 after X ticks while logged in since fur is last stolen from the stall.

name: marketthief_silver
description: Set to 1 when the player has stolen from the silver stall in Ardougne or Kingstown of Great Kourend. The silver merchant in east ardougne will recognise the player when this is set to 1. Set to 0 after X consecutive ticks while logged in since silver is last stolen from the stall.

name: marketthief_spice
description: Set to 1 when the player has stolen from the Ardougne Spice Stall. in Ardougne. The Spice seller in east ardougne will recognise the player when this is set to 1. Set to 0 after X consecutive ticks while logged in since spice is last stolen from the stall.

name: marketthief_gem
description: Set to 1 when the player has stolen from the Ardougne Gem Stall. in Ardougne. The Gem merchant in east ardougne will recognise the player when this is set to 1. Set to 0 after X consecutive ticks while logged in since gems have last been stolen from the stall.

name: marketthief_vikingfish
description: Set to 1 when the player has stolen from a Fish stall in Rellekka. The Fremennik Fish Monger in Rellekka will recognise the player when this is set to 1. Set to 0 after X consecutive ticks while logged in since fish has last been stolen from the stall.

name: marketthief_vikingfur
description: Set to 1 when the player has stolen from a Fur stall in Rellekka. The fur trader in Rellekka will recognise the player when this is set to 1. Set to 0 after X consecutive ticks while logged in since fur has last been stolen from the stall.

name: marketthief_miscfish
description: Set to 1 when the player has stolen from a Fish stall in Miscellania. The Fishmonger in Miscellania will recognise the player when this is set to 1. Set to 0 after X consecutive ticks while logged in since fish has last been stolen from the stall.

name: marketthief_miscveg
description: Set to 1 when the player has stolen from a Veg stall in Miscellania. The Greengrocer in Miscellania will recognise the player when this is set to 1. Set to 0 after X consecutive ticks while logged in since a vegetable has last been stolen from the stall.

name: marketthief_etcfish
description: Set to 1 when the player has stolen from a Fish stall in Etceteria. The Fishmonger in Etceteria will recognise the player when this is set to 1. Set to 0 after X consecutive ticks while logged in since fish has last been stolen from the stall.

name: marketthief_tea
description: Set to 1 when the player has stolen from a Tea stall in Varrock. The Tea Seller in Varrock will recognise the player when this is set to 1. Set to 0 after 1000 consecutive ticks while logged in since tea has last been stolen from the stall.

name: fenk_gardener_directions
description: Tracks whether Gardener Ghost is currently following the player. ==Values== ;0 Default state. After digging up his head or going out-of-bounds this will also be set to 0 and he will stop following the player and return to the castle. ;1 After starting Creature of Fenkenstrain, the Gardener Ghost will offer to follow the player to show them where his head is buried in the Haunted Woods. If he returns before collecting his head, then he can become a follower again.

name: shadeattack
description: Tracks whether a shade has transformed upon becoming aggressive towards a player. While the value is set to 1, other shades and shadows will not be aggressive towards the player.

name: pet_insurance_abyssalsirepet
description: Set to 1 when the player insures the Abyssal orphan with Probita. Set to 0 otherwise. While these are exposed as varbits, the client actually uses the underlying varplayer 866 as a bitmap.

name: ahoy_grinder_status
description: Tracks the current state of the bone grinder. ==Values== ;0 Default value, the bone grinder has no bones in the hopper or bin. ;1 There are bones in the grinder. ;2 There are bones in the bin.

name: ahoy_questvar
description: This is the main var that tracks the progress in Ghosts Ahoy. ==Values==

name: bounty_teleport_warning
description: Tracks whether the in-game setting Show warning when casting: Teleport to Target is enabled. == Values == {| class="wikitable" |- ! Value !! Description |- | 0 || Setting is disabled, no warning will be shown and the teleport will complete. |- | 1 || Setting is enabled, a chat warning will be shown requiring additional confirmation to complete the teleport. |}

name: slayer_unlock_fossilwyvernblock
description: Set to 1 when "Stop the Wyvern" is bought from the Slayer Reward Shop. While these are exposed as varbits, the client actually uses the underlying varplayers as a bitmap.

name: fossil_driftnet_unlimitedaccess
description: Set to 1 once Ceto is paid for access to an instanced version of the drift net fishing area underwater.

name: checklandinglights
description: Each bit in this var tracks whether one of the 8 gnome landing lights have had their uncut gems removed during One Small Favour. ==Values== At the start, this varbit is set to 0, and removing an uncut gem from each light will set the corresponding bit. Once all the lights have been removed, the varbit will have reached its maximum value of 255. As an example, removing each of the uncut gems from the north strip of lights will result in a varbit value of 15, the sum of 1, 2, 4, and 8. {|class=wikitable !Bit !Light |- |0 |North uncut jade |- |1 |North uncut red topaz |- |2 |North uncut opal |- |3 |North uncut sapphire |- |4 |South uncut jade |- |5 |South uncut red topaz |- |6 |South uncut opal |- |7 |South uncut sapphire |}

name: all_lights_fixed
description: Checks whether the player has seen the cutscene where the repaired gnome landing lights are lit during One Small Favour. ==Values== ;0 Default value. ;1 Sets once the player tells Gnormadium Avlafrim that they have fixed the lights and a short cutscene plays. During this cutscene, the gnome landing lights become flashing landing lights.

name: petracameraview
description: Checks whether the player has seen the cutscene highlighting Petra Fiyed trapped as a sculpture during One Small Favour. ==Values== ;0 Default value. ;1 Sets once the player first walks near the sculpture and the short cutscene plays.

name: mdaughter_quest_var
description: This is the main var that tracks the progress in Mountain Daughter. ==Values==

name: mdaughter_mud_var
description: Tracks whether mud has been applied to the tall tree during the Mountain Daughter quest. ==Values== ;0 Default value ;1 Set to 1 after mud has been used on the tall tree.

name: mdaughter_brundt_done
description: Set to 1 once the player asks Brundt the Chieftain about the mountain camp and completes the dialogue. Set to 0 otherwise.

name: autocast_spell
description: This varbit tracks which spell you have selected to autocast. ==Values== * 1 - Wind Strike * 2 - Water Strike * 3 - Earth Strike * 4 - Fire Strike * 5 - Wind Bolt * 6 - Water Bolt * 7 - Earth Bolt * 8 - Fire Bolt * 9 - Wind Blast * 10 - Water Blast * 11 - Earth Blast * 12 - Fire Blast * 13 - Wind Wave * 14 - Water Wave * 15 - Earth Wave * 16 - Fire Wave * 17 - Crumble Undead * 18 - Magic Dart * 19 - Claws of Guthix * 20 - Flames of Zamorak * 31 - Smoke Rush * 32 - Shadow Rush * 33 - Blood Rush * 34 - Ice Rush * 35 - Smoke Burst * 36 - Shadow Burst * 37 - Blood Burst * 38 - Ice Burst * 39 - Smoke Blitz * 40 - Shadow Blitz * 41 - Blood Blitz * 42 - Ice Blitz * 43 - Smoke Barrage * 44 - Shadow Barrage * 45 - Blood Barrage * 46 - Ice Barrage * 47 - Iban Blast * 48 - Wind Surge * 49 - Water Surge * 50 - Earth Surge * 51 - Fire Surge * 52 - Saradomin strike * 53 - Inferior Demonbane * 54 - Superior Demonbane * 55 - Dark Demonbane * 56 - Ghostly Grasp * 57 - Skeletal Grasp * 58 - Undead Grasp

name: cave_goblin_trust
description: Telling the cave goblins in the Lumbridge Swamp Caves that you won't hurt them flips the varbit to 1. This allows you to talk to them and be gifted a tinderbox. Killing a cave goblin flips this varbit back to 0. Persists across logins.

name: swamp_candle_guy_conversation
description: Permanent switch for initial dialogue options for the Candle seller, allowing the player to ask "How do you make lanterns?" ==Values== ;0 - Default ;1 Set to 1 after the dialogue "But I bet you want to find out what's down there right now, don't you? And you can pay me 1000 gold for the privilege!" and after "But if all that's too complicated, you can buy a candle right here for 1000 gold!"

name: dwarfrock_quest
description: This is the main var that tracks the progress in Between a Rock.... ==Values==

name: dwarfrock_fired_gold_cannonball
description: This varbit is set to 1 once you've given the golden cannonball to Dondakan. It stops the cannon from visually firing regular cannonballs.

name: feud_var_talk_gangs
description: Tracks which gang members during The Feud the player has agreed to get a camel for. ==Values== Talking to members of each gang sets their respective bits; once both bits are set, the quest continues and the player sets off to acquire some camels. {|class=wikitable !Bit !Gang |- |0 |Bandits |- |1 |Menaphites |}

name: feud_var_comp_gangs
description: Tracks which gang members during The Feud the player has given a receipt to. ==Values== Giving a receipt to a member of each gang sets their respective bits; once both bits are set, the quest continues and the player decides to take a more direct route towards solving the feud. {|class=wikitable !Bit !Gang |- |0 |Bandits |- |1 |Menaphites |}

name: feud_var_drink
description: This varbit counts how many beers the player has given Drunken Ali in the early part of The Feud. ==Values== ;0 Default value. ;1 One beer. ;2 Two beers. ;3 Three beers. The quest now continues.

name: feud_var_urchin
description: Tracks whether the player has paid the street urchin for helping distract a villager during The Feud. ==Values== ;0 Default value. ;1 The player has paid the street urchin, either right away or after refusing to pay earlier ;2 Refused to pay street urchin. Talking to the urchin again will give new dialogue with the option to pay him again, which sets the value to 1.

name: feud_var_mayorsdoor
description: Tracks whether the player has unlocked Ali the Mayor's house using the keys during The Feud. ==Values== ;0 Default value. ;1 The player has unlocked the doors.

name: feud_var_drink_found
description: Checks whether the player has gotten information about Traitorous Ali's whereabouts from Ali the Barman during The Feud. ==Values== ;0 Default value. ;1 Sets once the player asks Ali the Barman about Traitorous Ali.

name: feud_var_menaboss
description: Checks whether the player has talked to the Menaphite Leader and betrayed the Menaphites. The Tough Guy spawns immediately after this dialogue. ==Values== ;0 Default value. ;1 Sets once the player tells the Menaphite Leader: "Sorry, I have this irrational hatred for megalomaniac, despotic zealots! Prepare to meet your maker, you big jerk!"

name: feud_var_banditboss
description: Checks whether the player has talked to the Bandit Leader and betrayed the Bandits. The Bandit champion spawns immediately after this dialogue. ==Values== ;0 Default value. ;1 Sets once the Bandit Leader says: "Pollnivneach is mine. You won't run me out without a fight. If you want us gone, you must defeat our strongest warrior in battle."

name: feud_safe_digit
description: Counts up the amount of numbers entered into the safe in Ali the Mayor's house during The Feud. ==Values== ;0 Default value. Resets to this value after opening the safe, leaving the interface, or entering seven numbers. ;1-7 Amount of numbers entered.

name: feud_safe_correct
description: Sets when the player is entering numbers into the safe in Ali the Mayor's house during The Feud. ==Values== ;0 Default value. Resets to this after entering all numbers or otherwise leaving safe interface. ;1 Sets when the player begins entering numbers into the safe.

name: feud_hag_list
description: Checks status of the player getting a desert snake for Ali the Hag during The Feud. ==Values== ;0 Default value. ;1 Sets once Ali the Hag asks the player to get her a snake. ;2 Sets once the player gives the Snake basket full to Ali the Hag.

name: feud_ali_money
description: Checks whether the player has been given the coins reward by Ali Morrisane at the end of The Feud. ==Values== ;0 Default value. ;1 Ali Morrisane has given the player 500 coins at the end of The Feud.

name: feud_var
description: This is the main var that tracks the progress in The Feud. ==Values==

name: feud_boss_vis
description: Checks whether the Menaphite Leader should be visible, depending on var state. ==Values== ;0 Default value. Returns to this after the player defeats the Tough Guy, right before the Menaphite Leader appears to teleport away. ;1 Sets to this value once the player poisons Traitorous Ali's drink.

name: feud_boss_vis2
description: Sets when the Menaphite Leader is teleporting away, after the player defeats the Tough Guy ==Values== ;0 Default value. Returns to this after the Menaphite Leader finishes teleporting away. ;1 Sets to this value once the player defeats the Tough Guy and the Menaphite Leader begins to teleport away.

name: feud_bandit_boss_vis
description: Sets the visibility of the Bandit Leader during The Feud. ==Values== ;0 Default value. Bandit Leader invisible. Resets to this after Ali the Mayor talks to the player about Ali Morrisane's nephew and tells them to report back about it. ;1 Bandit Leader visible. Sets once a villager tells the player "If you're prepared to change something you must also be prepared to deal with the consequences! Now hurry up and fix this mess you created!"

name: feud_given_jewels
description: Checks whether the player has handed in the Jewels stolen from Ali the Mayor's house to Ali the Operator. ==Values== ;0 Default value. ;1 Sets once the player hands the jewels to Ali the Operator.

name: feud_npc_multi
description: Tracks which methods of pickpocketing the player knows and can be used on the residents of Pollnivneach. At the start of the quest, the various Villagers, Bandits, and Menaphite Thugs will only have a "Pickpocket" option. As the quest progresses, the player learns new methods and the various NPCs gain the "Lure" and "Knock-Out" options. ==Values== ;0 Default value. NPCs only have a "Pickpocket" option. ;1 Sets once the player pickpockets a villager once. NPCs gain the "Lure" option. ;2 Sets once the player pickpockets a lured villager. NPCs gain the "Knock-Out" option.

name: feud_report_drink
description: Deals with the warning the player can give Ali the Barman about the poisoned beer near the end of The Feud or after the quest is over. ==Values== ;0 Default value. ;1 Sets once the player talks to Ali the Barman after the quest, where he will have the "Could you tell Traitorous Ali that someone has poisoned his drink?" option in his dialogue. ;2 Sets once the player accepts the thank-you beer from Ali the Barman.

name: feud_found_trait
description: Checks whether the player has discovered the identity of the traitor amongst the Menaphites. ==Values== ;0 Default value. ;1 Sets once a Menaphite Thug tells the player that Traitorous Ali is the Menaphite traitor. The player can then report this information back to Ali the Operator to continue the quest.

name: golem_a
description: This is the main var that tracks the progress in The Golem. ==Values==

name: golem_throne_gems
description: Set to 1 once the gems from Agrith Naar's throne have been removed.

name: deserttreasure
description: This is the main var that tracks the progress in Desert Treasure I. ==Values==

name: ics_little_var
description: This is the main var that tracks the progress in Icthlarin's Little Helper. ==Values==

name: tog_juna_bowl
description: This tracks the progress in Tears of Guthix. ==Values== ;0 Default state. Quest not started. ;1 After the player accepts the quest and Juna tells the player they need a bowl made from stones in the southern part of the cave she is in to catch the Tears of Guthix. ;2 After handing Juna the stone bowl and she says "Now... tell me another story, and I will let you collect the tears for the first time. Quest complete.

name: tog_minigame_collecting
description: This varbit is set to 1 when collecting tears, whether blue or green, and set to 0 when not collecting tears.

name: tog_tears_collected
description: Your current number of points (blue minus green tears), which determines how much XP you get. This is also used to fill in the bowl graphic, although it appears to max out at 46 tears. It goes up or down by 1 every tick you are using the bowl on a blue or green stream respectively, which is one tick after varbit 453 is changed.

name: tog_qp_before_return
description: This is the number of quest points you'll need to attain in order to use Tears of Guthix next week. It's set to QUEST_POINTS + 1 when you finish, and it's how it checks whether you have done quests since last week.

name: barrows_killed_monster
description: Tracks your Barrows reward potential, which is the sum of the combat levels of monsters you've killed, maxing out at 1000. Resets when you re-enter a crypt after looting.

name: zogre
description: This is the main var that tracks the progress in Zogre Flesh Eaters. ==Values==

name: lost_tribe_quest
description: This is the main var that tracks the progress in The Lost Tribe. ==Values==

name: lost_tribe_returned_brooch
description: Set to 1 when the player returns the brooch to Mistag. Set to 0 otherwise.

name: lost_tribe_hole_2_dug
description: Set to 1 once the tunnel connecting the Lumbridge Swamp Caves and the Dorgesh-Kaan mine is unblocked.

name: cutscene_status
description: Set to 1 if the minimap should be hidden (usually due to cutscenes). Set back to 0 when the cutscene is over.

name: giantdwarf_quest
description: This is the main var that tracks the progress in The Giant Dwarf. ==Values==

name: marketthief_seed
description: Set to 1 when the player has stolen from either Seed Stall in Draynor Village. Olivia will recognise the player when this is set to 1. Set to 0 after 1,000 consecutive ticks while logged in since seeds were last stolen from one of the stalls.

name: wom_task
description: Tracks if the player has met Wise Old Man (Dionysius) at Draynor Village and changes his dialogue slightly. Probably also changes Miss Schism's standard dialogue, and the allowance of using items on Wise Old Man. ==Values== * 0 when the player has not met Wise Old Man before at Draynor Village. Initial dialogue plays: So you're a wise old man, huh? The player can't use items on Wise Old Man: Humph! You could at least say hello before waving your items in my face. * 1 when the player has met him. Set when Wise Old Man exclaims: Well, I imagine you've gathered up quite a lot of stuff on your travels. Things you used for quests a long time ago that you don't need now. Changes his dialogue/skips the introduction dialogue.

name: gnometracker_h
description: If the player has asked about and gone through the dialogue with Tracker gnome 3 to learn the coordinate used in the ballista targeting. ==Values== Set to 0, by default. Set to 1 after going through the dialogue with Tracker gnome 1 to learn the coordinates.

name: gnometracker_y
description: If the player has asked about and gone through the dialogue with Tracker gnome 2 to learn the coordinate used in the ballista targeting. ==Values== Set to 0, by default. Set to 1 after going through the dialogue with Tracker gnome 2 to learn the coordinates.

name: gnometracker_x
description: If the player has asked about and gone through the dialogue with Tracker gnome 3 to learn the riddle for the coordinate used in the ballista targeting. ==Values== Set to 0, by default. Set to 1 after going through the dialogue and learning the riddle from Tracker gnome 3.

name: kourend_tasks_overlay
description: Toggles whether or not to show the Kourend favour UI. Can be turned on or off in the Kourend Favour tab of the quest interface.

name: edgeville_spawn_unlocked
description: Set to 1 after purchasing the Edgeville respawn location from Krystilia.

name: rd_main
description: This is the main var that tracks the progress in Recruitment Drive. ==Values==

name: ga
description: This varbit keeps track of the player's progress during Getting Ahead. ==Values== Note that state 6 can be skipped by putting flour on the fence immediately after talking to Mary. ; 0 : The quest has not been started ; 2 : The quest is started: You've started a new quest: . Gordon tells you to go talk to Mary after agreeing to start the quest "Well it can't be living too far from here, but I don't know exactly where. You might want to check with my wife, Mary. Perhaps she's seen something I haven't." The quest list entry is rewritten; the quest's requirements and starting location are removed from it. ; 4 : Mary tells you about her idea "Oh! I have an idea! If this beast ended up getting coated in flour, it wouldn't be hard for you to track it back to its home." The player can now use flour on the gate (previously: "Nothing interesting happens."). The quest list entry is updated. ; 6 : Gordon mentions that the beast is going after his cattle "It's mainly been going for the cattle. I fixed up a new gate which has kept it out the past couple of nights. Not sure how long it will hold though." The quest list entry is updated. ; 8 : The player uses flour on the gate. The quest list entry is updated (in a slightly backwards way): Gordon's wife, Mary, suggested I track the Beast back to its Lair by covering it in Flour. is still an active task in the quest list entry. A forced queue of uncancellable events / stalls happen to progress to 10. The player can no longer use flour on the gate ("Nothing interesting happens.")? ; 10 : The player waits overnight after continuing the dialogue from putting flour on the gate (value changes to 10 after the screen turns black). The quest list entry is updated. Flour ground objects (ID 40429) appear on the ground at eight locations (leading to the cave): 1255,3684,0; 1256,3678,0; 1255,3665,0; 1248,3658,0; 1236,3657,0; 1226,3656,0; 1217,3655,0; 1213,3649,0. The cave with the headless beast becomes available (previously: You don't have reason to enter this dark and spooky cave.). ; 12 : Enter the cave with the headless beast. Cowhides are found on the ground. The quest list entry is updated. ; 14 : Kill the headless beast. The cave entrance no longer gives a warning about being dangerous, but can be re-entered. Cowhides and the headless beast are removed from the cave. The flour trail is removed from the world and the gate becomes clean of flour. The quest list entry is updated. ; 16 : Gordon tells you to come back if you find a head "Well if you manage to get hold of the beast's head, let me know. Until then, I can't pay you." Gordon now has dialogue when using big bones, ensouled bear head, etc, instead of "Nothing interesting happens." Using a knife on soft clay remains at "Nothing interesting happens." The quest list entry is updated. ; 18 : Mary tells you to make a fake head "That's the spirit! I've tried my hand at clay modelling in the past. You can make all sorts of things. Just get some soft clay and a knife and I'm sure you'll be able to make a lovely head." The quest list entry is updated. The player can now sculpt a clay head. ; 20 : Sculpt a clay head for the first time. No change of dialogue to Mary if the head is destroyed. The question "Sculpt a clay head?" is still present. If the player doesn't have a clay head in their inventory (can be banked), the quest dialogue is the same as above and says the player should make a head. If the player has a clay head in their inventory, the quest list entry displays alternative text. The fur head cannot be made yet: "Nothing interesting happens." The player is now allowed to use a clay head on Gordon (instead of talking to him). ; 22 : Gordon realizes the clay head is fake "Quite rare because they don't exist! I'm no fool, this is clearly a pretend head! It doesn't even have any fur!" The quest list entry is updated, and remains unchanged even if the player destroys or banks the clay head. The clay head can no longer be used on Gordon: "Nothing interesting happens." The player can now attach fur to a clay head to create a fur head. ; 24 : Attach fur to the clay head to get a fur head for the first time. No change of dialogue to Mary if the head is destroyed. If the player doesn't have a clay head in their inventory (can be banked), the quest dialogue is the same as above and says the player should make a fur head. If the player has a fur head in their inventory, the quest list entry displays alternative text. The player is now allowed to use a fur head on Gordon (instead of talking to him). ; 26 : Gordon realizes the fur head is fake "You must take me for an idiot! This is some head you bought from a taxidermist or something. It's clearly not a fresh kill!" Blood pint, raw bear meat and vial of blood can now be used on the fur head for easter egg messages (previously: "Nothing interesting happens."). The fur head can no longer be used on Gordon: "Nothing interesting happens." The player can now dye fur head red with a red dye to create a bloody head (previously: "Nothing interesting happens."). The quest list entry is updated. ; 28 : Use red dye on the fur head to get a bloody head for the first time. No change of dialogue to Mary if the head is destroyed. If the player doesn't have a bloody head in their inventory (can be banked), the quest dialogue is the same as above and says the player should make a bloody head. If the player has a bloody head in their inventory, the quest list entry displays alternative text. The player is now allowed to use a bloody head on Gordon (instead of talking to him). ; 30 : Gordon asks the player to mount the head in his home "A head like this deserves a place of honour! My friend, please could you mount it in our home?" The Mounted Head Space placeholder becomes visible in the house at this time. The bloody head can no longer be used on Gordon: "Nothing interesting happens." "Proofs" can no longer be used on Gordon: "Nothing interesting happens." The quest list entry is updated. ; 32 : Mount the head in the Mounted Head Space. All variants of the fake head are destroyed from the player's inventory and bank (and other storages?). The player can no longer craft the fake heads: "Nothing interesting happens." The quest list entry is updated. ; 34 : Finish the quest (immediately after the cutscene). Experience is rewarded and the quest is marked as completed. Mary's dialogue gains a new one-time chat option to unlock tanning services.

name: ga_reward
description: This is set to 1 when the player claims the coin reward from the Getting Ahead quest. If the player had a full inventory at the end of the quest (RS:Varbit/693 with a value of 34), this remains at 0. In such scenario, talking to Gordon after the quest with free inventory space for coins will reward the player 3,000 coins and set this to 1: Hello again. Thank you for dealing with that beast. There is no other indication when Gordon holds a reward for the player. This does not affect the quest log.

name: ga_journal
description: This is set to 1 when the player searches the skeleton found in the headless beast's cave during or after Getting Ahead. When 1, (likely) unlocks access to the book at bookcases in player-owned houses.

name: ga_mary_dialogue
description: This is set to 1 when talking to Mary after completing Getting Ahead. This gives the player access to Mary's hide tanning services, adds a "Trade" option to Mary and slightly changes Mary's dialogue. Claiming the 3,000 Coins reward is optional.

name: ga_gordon_met
description: This is set to 1 after a player has introduced themselves to Gordon (When we heard, we decided to come up here and start up our own farm.) and slightly changes Gordon's dialogue before starting the quest if talked to again.

name: farming_tools_rake
description: The amount of rakes in your Tool Leprechaun is equal to 2 * varbit 8357 + varbit 1435, maxing out at 100 total. This was presumably done so that the total quantity could be increased from 1 to 100, but without changing/migrating the original varbit that was used to store it.

name: farming_tools_dibber
description: The amount of seed dibbers in your Tool Leprechaun is equal to 2 * varbit 8358 + varbit 1436, maxing out at 100 total. This was presumably done so that the total quantity could be increased from 1 to 100, but without changing/migrating the original varbit that was used to store it.

name: farming_tools_spade
description: The amount of spades in your Tool Leprechaun is equal to 2 * varbit 8361 + varbit 1437, maxing out at 100 total. This was presumably done so that the total quantity could be increased from 1 to 100, but without changing/migrating the original varbit that was used to store it.

name: farming_tools_secateurs
description: The amount of secateurs in your Tool Leprechaun is equal to 2 * varbit 8359 + varbit 1438, maxing out at 100 total. varbit 1848 controls whether they are magic secateurs or just regular secateurs. This was presumably done so that the total quantity could be increased from 1 to 100, but without changing/migrating the original varbit that was used to store it.

name: farming_tools_trowel
description: The amount of gardening trowels in your Tool Leprechaun is equal to 2 * varbit 8360 + varbit 1440, maxing out at 100 total. This was presumably done so that the total quantity could be increased from 1 to 100, but without changing/migrating the original varbit that was used to store it.

name: farming_tools_buckets
description: The amount of buckets in your Tool Leprechaun is equal to 256 * varbit 6265 + 32 * varbit 4731 + varbit 1441, maxing out at 1000 total. This was presumably done so that the maximum quantity could be increased to 1000 (previous maximums unknown), but without changing/migrating the original varbit that was used to store it. This was done to nearly every item in the tool storage, but buckets are unique in that the maximum was resized twice, and thus use 3 distinct varbits.

Varbit resets to 0 upon leaving the water. ==Values== ;0 Default value. ;1-4 Incremental values. ;5 Maximum value. Attempting to pick up any more rocks at this point will give the message:

After getting verbal permission from Nung at Varbit 1895 value 80, attempting to enter the crab pen will trigger a short dialogue from a Mogre Guard, at which point this Varbit will switch to 1 and the player will no longer be harassed by the guards while trying to enter the crab pen. ==Values== ;0 Default value, Mogre Guard will stop the player from entering the crab pen. ;1 Sets to 1 once the player explains that Nung said it was okay to enter the crab pen, at which point the guards will no longer stop the player from entering.

name: hundred_pirate_first_dive
description: Tracks whether the player has dove down to the Mogre Camp. ==Values== ;0 Default value. ;1 Sets to 1 once the player dives to the Mogre Camp for the first time.

description: Tracks whether the player knows how to make ground kelp by using a pestle and mortar on a kelp. name: templetrek_npc_point_value
description: This varbit tracks the score of the current Temple Trekking run. Upon receiving a reward token at the end of a trek or leaving a trek early, this varbit is set to 0.

name: templetrek_button_control
description: This is set to 1 when right when you leave Burgh de Rott or Paterdomus. It's set to 0 when you leave Temple Trekking via a teleport or by "Escape"-ing the Trek, and also set to zero when you go to the next event. If no event is encountered on the Trek, this value stays at 1. This can also be kept at 1 by logging out mid trek. When players log out in an instance, they always log in on the last non-instance tile they visited. This is also the case for Temple Trekking. The varbit is most likely used to teleport the player back in the minigame, in case its value equals 1 when logging in and the player is close enough to one of the minigame starting locations.

name: templetrek_last_event
description: Value keeps track of the last event encountered in Temple Trekking. name: soulbane_prog
description: This is the main var that tracks the progress in A Soul's Bane. ==Values== ;0 Default state. Quest has not been started ;1 Quest has been started upon the player saying Don't worry. I'll investigate. to Launa. ;2 Upon entering the rage room for the first time after hearing Tolna's voice and exiting the cutscene. ;3 After filling the rage level bar to the maximum, RuneScape:Varbit/2036 will be >1500 and RuneScape:Varbit/2042 will flip to 1 causing an animation. After the animation is completed, 2011 is set to 3. ;4 After listening to the dialogue at the start of the fear room and the player character talks and is controllable. ;5 After killing the last fear reaper, when RuneScape:Varbit/2019 is set to 5. ;6 Upon leaving the forced camera animation in the confusion room. ;7 Upon killing the last real confusion beast, also revealing the final door and despawning any remaining beasts. ;8 Upon all the hopeless creatures spawning. ;9 Upon killing the last hopeless creature. ;10 Upon leaving the cutscene with monster version of Tolna, his father, and the player. ;11 Upon killing all 3 of the monster Tolna. ;12 Upon being ejected from the rift after talking to Tolna and his father. ;13 After the player says "Thanks." to Tolna outside the rift. Quest complete.

name: soulbane_fear_enemydoor
description: This tracks the location of where the next fear reaper is going to be found. RuneScape:Varbit/2027 takes on the value after killing the fear reaper when 2012 is given a value. Locations are numbers 0 to 5, when facing north in the room, dark hole 0 is directly to the right of the entrance/exit. Set to 0 on quest completion.

name: poh_menagerie_closed
description: Set to 0 if the player's pets are allowed to roam. Set to 1 if the player's pets are not allowed to roam. This can be toggled at the pet house in a Player-owned house.

name: soulbane_confu_door1pres
description: Once the first round's real confusion beast is killed this is set to 1 and one of the confusing doors is removed. Value is reset to 0 when leaving the room early. Set to 0 on quest completion.

name: soulbane_confu_door2pres
description: Once the second round's real confusion beast is killed this is set to 1 and one of the confusing doors is removed. Value is reset to 0 when leaving the room early. Set to 0 on quest completion.

name: soulbane_confu_door3pres
description: Once the third round's real confusion beast is killed this is set to 1 and one of the confusing doors is removed. Value is reset to 0 when leaving the room early. Set to 0 on quest completion.

name: soulbane_confu_door4pres
description: Once the fourth round's real confusion beast is killed this is set to 1 and one of the confusing doors is removed. Value is reset to 0 when leaving the room early. Set to 0 on quest completion.

name: soulbane_confu_door5pres
description: Once the fifth round's real confusion beast is killed this is set to 1 and one of the confusing doors is removed. Value is reset to 0 when leaving the room early. Set to 0 on quest completion.

name: soulbane_fear_killedtally
description: Tracks the number of kills of fear reapers. Sets to zero when entering the room. Counts up to 5, at 5 makes 2011 go to 5. Set to 0 on quest completion.

name: soulbane_hope_bridgepres
description: After killing the 5 hopeless creatures, tracked tracked by RuneScape:Varbit/2021, the bright bridge across the chasm appears, and the final boss room is now accessible.

name: soulbane_hope_killedtally
description: Tracks the number of hopeless creatures kills during A Soul's Bane, up to 5. Resets to 0 when prematurely leaving the room. Set to 0 on quest completion.

name: soulbane_final_tol1dead
description: Set to 1 when the eastern head of Tolna's body is killed by the player. Set to 0 if the player leaves the fight early. Set to 0 on quest completion.

name: soulbane_final_tol2dead
description: Set to 1 when the southern head of Tolna's body is killed by the player. Set to 0 if the player leaves the fight early. Set to 0 on quest completion.

name: soulbane_final_tol3dead
description: Set to 1 when the northern head of Tolna's body is killed by the player. Set to 0 if the player leaves the fight early. Set to 0 on quest completion.

name: soulbane_tolna_pres
description: When 2011 is set to 12, this is flipped to show Tolna in the main world.

name: soulbane_launa_pres
description: When 2011 is set to 12, this is flipped to hide Launa.

name: soulbane_fear_enemydoor_old
description: This tracks the location of where the most recent fear reaper was found and killed. RuneScape:Varbit/2012 is the current location of the next and upon dean 2027 takes this value. Locations are numbers 0 to 5, when facing north in the room, dark hole 0 is directly to the right of the entrance/exit.

name: soulbane_anger_flamepres
description: After filling the rage level track by confusion beasts and the extra doors being removed, tracked by RuneScape:Varbit/2036 and RuneScape:Varbit/2042, the fire blocking the exit towards the fear room is gone, and the exit is now enter-able to access the fear room.

name: soulbane_anger_weaponmulti
description: Tracks which anger weapon is currently in the player's possession from the weapon rack. ==Values== ;0 Default state, set to 0 whenever choosing a new weapon, when leaving the rift, or upon advancing into the fear room. ;1 Set to 1 upon obtaining the anger sword ;2 Set to 2 upon obtaining the anger spear ;3 Set to 3 upon obtaining the anger mace ;4 Set to 4 upon obtaining the anger battleaxe

name: soulbane_fear_exitlit
description: After killing 5 fear reapers, tracked by RuneScape:Varbit/2019, and RuneScape:Varbit/2011 being set to 5, the black hole becomes bright with light, and can be entered to the confusion room.

name: soulbane_confu_door6open
description: After killing the 5 real confusion beasts and the extra doors being removed, tracked by RuneScape:Varbit/2014, RuneScape:Varbit/2015, RuneScape:Varbit/2016, RuneScape:Varbit/2017, and RuneScape:Varbit/2018, the last remaining confusion door is now enter-able to access the hopeless room.

name: soulbane_riftrope_pres
description: Set to 1 after a rope is used on Tolna's rift entrance during the A Soul's Bane quest.

name: soulbane_final_seencut
description: Once the fight begins, this is set to 1 so that leaving and re-entering does not replay all the dialogue.

name: soulbane_warning_pres
description: Set to 1 on completion of the quest. Grant access to Tolna's rift combat area, and replaces the grass around the rift with warning signs.

name: soulbane_fear_monspres
description: Set to 1 when a fear reaper is spawned in the room, set to 0 upon leaving the room or killing it.

name: soulbane_anger_damagedealt
description: Counts the amount of damage dealt in the anger room during A Soul's Bane. After reaching 1500 the anger room is completed. Sets to zero if prematurely leaving the anger room.

name: soulbane_confu_hitcount1
description: Counters the number of hits on the fake confusion beast (ID:1068). Starts at 0 and goes up to 8. At 8, the fake confusion beast dies. Once the real confusion beast is killed the value is set to 0. Leaving the confusion room will reset the value to 0.

name: soulbane_confu_hitcount2
description: Counters the number of hits on the fake confusion beast (ID:1069). Starts at 0 and goes up to 8. At 8, the fake confusion beast dies. Once the real confusion beast is killed the value is set to 0. Leaving the confusion room will reset the value to 0.

name: soulbane_confu_hitcount3
description: Counters the number of hits on the fake confusion beast (ID:1070). Starts at 0 and goes up to 8. At 8, the fake confusion beast dies. Once the real confusion beast is killed the value is set to 0. Leaving the confusion room will reset the value to 0.

name: soulbane_confu_hitcount4
description: Counters the number of hits on the fake confusion beast (ID:1071). Starts at 0 and goes up to 8. At 8, the fake confusion beast dies. Once the real confusion beast is killed the value is set to 0. Leaving the confusion room will reset the value to 0.

name: soulbane_anger_donespecial
description: After the rage level has been filled, from RuneScape:Varbit/2036 going above 1500, this is switched to 1.

name: rag_potboiler
description: This varbit represents which bone in vinegar is in the pot-boiler during Rag and Bone Man I. ==Values== {| class="wikitable" |+ Caption text |- ! Value !! Status |- | 0 || No bones in pot-boiler |- | 1 || Goblin skull in pot-boiler |- | 2 || Bear ribs in pot-boiler |- | 3 || Ram skull in pot-boiler |- | 4 || Unicorn bone in pot-boiler |- | 5 || Giant rat bone in pot-boiler |- | 6 || Giant bat wing in pot-boiler |- | 15 || Monkey paw in pot-boiler |- | 33 || Big frog leg in pot-boiler |}

name: rag_boiler
content: Rag and Bone Man I, Pot-boiler
description: This varbit enum represents the state of the pot-boiler. ==Values== {| class="wikitable" |- ! Value !! State |- | 0 || Empty pot-boiler |- | 1 || Logs under pot-boiler |- | 2 || Bones in pot-boiler |- | 3 || Light pot-boiler |- | 4 || Bones are ready |}

name: fishingcompo_passed
description: This varbit tracks whether the player has shown their Fishing pass to Morris at the gate into the Hemenster fishing contest during Fishing Contest quest. This varbit does not change if the player clicks the gate itself to enter the area, only when the Fishing pass is manually used on Morris and the dialogue is progressed to dialog. The value starts at 0, changes to 1 when the pass is shown, and resets back to 0 when the player enters through the gate.

name: emote_bunny_hop
description: Defaults to 0 for new accounts. Set to 1 when the Rabbit Hop emote is unlocked, usually accompanied with a message: You've unlocked an emote: .

name: elemental_workshop_book
description: Checks whether the player has read the Battered book to start Elemental Workshop I. ==Values== ;0 Default value. ;1 Sets once the player reads the Battered book and opts to start the quest.

name: elemental_workshop_key
description: Checks whether the player has slashed the Battered book open to obtain the Battered key. ==Values== ;0 Default value. ;1 Sets once the player slashes the Battered book.

name: elemental_workshop_gate1
description: Checks whether the left set of water controls are closed or open in Elemental Workshop I. ==Values== ;0 Default value, set again if the player turns the water control to close the flow. In this state the water does not flow and the controls show a red indicator. ;1 Set once the player turns the water control to open. Water flows and controls show a green indicator.

name: elemental_workshop_gate2
description: Checks whether the right set of water controls are closed or open in Elemental Workshop I. ==Values== ;0 Default value, set again if the player turns the water control to close the flow. In this state the water does not flow and the controls show a red indicator. ;1 Set once the player turns the water control to open. Water flows and controls show a green indicator.

name: elemental_workshop_switch
description: Checks whether the water is flowing in Elemental Workshop I. ==Values== ;0 Default value. ;1 Set once the player pulls the lever in the water section of the workshop, causing the water to flow.

name: elemental_workshop_bellows
description: Checks whether the bellows have been repaired during Elemental Workshop I. ==Values== ;0 Default value. ;1 Set once the player repairs the bellows using a needle, thread, and leather.

name: elemental_workshop_fire
description: Checks whether the furnace has been lit during Elemental Workshop I. ==Values== ;0 Default value. ;1 Set once the player lights the furnace using a stone bowl full of lava.

name: elemental_workshop_bellows_switch
description: Checks whether the air from the bellows is blowing in Elemental Workshop I. ==Values== ;0 Default value. ;1 Set once the player pulls the lever in the air section of the workshop, causing the repaired bellows to start pumping air.

name: elemental_workshop_stairs
description: Checks whether the player has entered the Elemental Workshop during Elemental Workshop I. ==Values== ;0 Default value. ;1 Set once the player enters the Elemental Workshop for the first time.

name: elemental_workshop_leather
description: Checks whether the player has taken the leather from one of the crates during Elemental Workshop I. Unlike some other materials such as a stone bowl which can be obtained any number of times, this varbit ensures that the leather can only be obtained once. ==Values== ;0 Default value. ;1 Set once the player searches the proper crate and takes the leather from it.

name: elemental_workshop_finished
description: Checks whether the player has crafted the elemental shield and completed Elemental Workshop I. ==Values== ;0 Default value. ;1 Set once the player makes the elemental shield and completes the quest.

name: motherlode_in_restricted_area
description: Changes to 1 when you go up a "floor" in Motherlode Mine by going up the ladder, and 0 if you go back down. Since Motherlode Mine is actually all on one plane, this adds or removes the "Climb" option on the ladders.

name: swansong
description: This is the main var that tracks the progress in Swan Song. ==Values==

name: swansong_pickaxe
description: Set to 1 when you take the bronze pickaxe from Piscatoris Fishing Colony. Set to 0 otherwise.

name: swansong_hatchet
description: Set to 1 when you take the bronze axe from Piscatoris Fishing Colony. Set to 0 otherwise.

name: royal_quest
description: This is the main var that tracks the progress in Royal Trouble. ==Values==

name: pet_insurance2_overview
description: This varbit (along with varplayer 866) contains the insurance status of all pets for the player. Varplayer 866 contains data for the first 32 pets, while varbit 2168 contains data for all remaining pets 33 to 50. The following values can be used to identify the insured pets:

name: pet_insurance_skillpetagility
description: Set to 1 when the player insures the Giant squirrel with Probita. Set to 0 otherwise. While these are exposed as varbits, the client actually uses the underlying varplayer 866 as a bitmap.

name: pet_insurance_skillpetfarming
description: Set to 1 when the player insures the Tangleroot with Probita. Set to 0 otherwise. While these are exposed as varbits, the client actually uses the underlying varplayer 866 as a bitmap.

name: pet_insurance_skillpetrunecraft
description: Set to 1 when the player insures the Rift guardian with Probita. Set to 0 otherwise. While these are exposed as varbits, the client actually uses the underlying varplayer 866 as a bitmap.

name: pet_insurance_skillpetthieving
description: Set to 1 when the player insures Rocky. Set to 0 otherwise. While this is exposed as a single-bit varbit, the client actually uses varbit 2168 instead as a bitmap. Both varbits come from the same varplayer 1417.

name: poh_menagerie2_overview
description: This varbit (along with varplayer 864) contains the menagerie storage status of all insurable pets for the player. varplayer 864 contains data for the first 32 pets, while varplayer 1416 contains data for all remaining pets 33 to 50. However, this varbit is not used by the client. Instead, the underlying Varplayer 1416 is used to generate the menagerie interface.

name: pet_menagerie_skillpetagility
description: Set to 1 when the Giant squirrel is put into a menagerie, and set to 0 when taken out. While these are exposed as varbits, the client actually uses the underlying varplayers as a bitmap. Cats, while able to be stored in a menagerie, are not kept with varbits – they are believed to be stored in an inventory.

name: pet_menagerie_skillpetfarming
description: Set to 1 when the Tangleroot is put into a menagerie, and set to 0 when taken out. While these are exposed as varbits, the client actually uses the underlying varplayers as a bitmap. Cats, while able to be stored in a menagerie, are not kept with varbits – they are believed to be stored in an inventory.

name: poh_building_mode
description: Tracks whether or not you're in building mode. Set to 1 if in building mode, 0 otherwise.

name: poh_house_location
description: Blocks the player from using experience lamps on Construction without owning a house first. ==Values== ; 0 : Player does not own a house. ; 1 : Set when the player buys their first house in Rimmington.

name: sheepherder_sheep_a
description: Tracks the current status of the plagued red sheep disposal process. ==Values== ;0 No red sheep has been prodded into the enclosure. Upon quest completion of Sheep Herder this is set to 0. ;1 A red sheep has been cattle prodded into the enclosure and is standing still. If the player does not pick up the sheep bones (1), another red sheep needs to be prodded into the enclosure. ;2 When...the sheep collapses dead onto the floor. after feeding it the poison sheep feed, it drops sheep bones (1). ;6 When The remains burn to dust. sheep bones (1) were put into the Incinerator and destroyed.

name: sheepherder_sheep_b
description: Tracks the current status of the plagued green sheep disposal process. ==Values== ;0 No green sheep has been prodded into the enclosure. Upon quest completion of Sheep Herder this is set to 0. ;1 A green sheep has been cattle prodded into the enclosure and is standing still. If the player does not pick up the sheep bones (2), another green sheep needs to be prodded into the enclosure. ;2 When...the sheep collapses dead onto the floor. after feeding it the poison sheep feed, it drops sheep bones (2). ;6 When The remains burn to dust. sheep bones (2) were put into the Incinerator and destroyed.

name: sheepherder_sheep_c
description: Tracks the current status of the plagued blue sheep disposal process. ==Values== ;0 No blue sheep has been prodded into the enclosure. Upon quest completion of Sheep Herder this is set to 0. ;1 A blue sheep has been cattle prodded into the enclosure and is standing still. If the player does not pick up the sheep bones (3), another blue sheep needs to be prodded into the enclosure. ;2 When...the sheep collapses dead onto the floor. after feeding it the poison sheep feed, it drops sheep bones (3). ;6 When The remains burn to dust. sheep bones (3) were put into the Incinerator and destroyed.

name: sheepherder_sheep_d
description: Tracks the current status of the plagued yellow sheep disposal process. ==Values== ;0 No yellow sheep has been prodded into the enclosure. Upon quest completion of Sheep Herder this is set to 0. ;1 A yellow sheep has been cattle prodded into the enclosure and is standing still. If the player does not pick up the sheep bones (4), another yellow sheep needs to be prodded into the enclosure. ;2 When...the sheep collapses dead onto the floor. after feeding it the poison sheep feed, it drops sheep bones (4). ;6 When The remains burn to dust. sheep bones (4) were put into the Incinerator and destroyed.

name: dttd_main
description: This is the main var that tracks the progress in Death to the Dorgeshuun. ==Values==

name: brew_hyper_yeast_brewery_1
description: Set to 1 once the player has added the stuff to the Keldagrim fermenting vat. Set to 0 after the fermenting vat's contents are drained into the collection barrel.

name: brew_hyper_yeast_brewery_2
description: Set to 1 once the player has added the stuff to the Port Phasmatys fermenting vat. Set to 0 after the fermenting vat's contents are drained into the collection barrel.

name: essencemine_portal
description: Determines which Portal (Rune essence mine) types are spawned for the player in the Rune essence mine. There still appears to be some randomization with same values so exact behaviour is still not known. ==Values== *0: Object, morph id 34774 or 34778 *1: Object, morph id 34775 or 34777 *2: NPC, morph id 3086 or 3088 *3: Object, morph id 34774 or 34776 *4: Object, morph id 34775 or 34777 *5: NPC, morph id 3086 or 3088 *6: NPC, morph id 3086 or 3088 *7: Object, morph id 34774 or 34778

name: rcu_essencespot_wizardstower
description: Set to 1 when the player is teleported by Archmage Sedridor to the Rune essence mine with the Scrying orb in their inventory. Initially set at 0.

name: rcu_essencespot_aubury
description: Set to 1 when the player is teleported by Aubury to the Rune essence mine with the Scrying orb in their inventory. Initially set at 0.

name: rcu_essencespot_cromperty
description: Set to 1 when the player is teleported by Wizard Cromperty to the Rune essence mine with the Scrying orb in their inventory. Initially set at 0.

name: rcu_essencespot_brimstail
description: Set to 1 when the player is teleported by Brimstail to the Rune essence mine with the Scrying orb in their inventory. Initially set at 0.

name: rcu_essencespot_wizardsguild
description: Set to 1 when the player is teleported by Wizard Distentor to the Rune essence mine with the Scrying orb in their inventory. Initially set at 0.

name: dream_plankspell_oak
description: Tracks whether the price confirmation message has been disabled when casting Plank Make on a Oak Log. == Values == {| class="wikitable" |- ! Value !! Description |- | 0 || The confirmation message has not been disabled, casting Plank Make on a Oak log prompts the player for additional confirmation. This will happen on every cast, including follow-up autocasts. |- | 1 || The confirmation message has been disabled, casting Plank Make on a Oak log works as expected. |}

name: dream_plankspell_teak
description: Tracks whether the price confirmation message has been disabled when casting Plank Make on a Teak Log. == Values == {| class="wikitable" |- ! Value !! Description |- | 0 || The confirmation message has not been disabled, casting Plank Make on a Teak log prompts the player for additional confirmation. This will happen on every cast, including follow-up autocasts. |- | 1 || The confirmation message has been disabled, casting Plank Make on a Teak log works as expected. |}

name: teletab_cemetery_warning
description: Tracks whether the in-game setting Show warning when using tablet: Cemetery is enabled. == Values == {| class="wikitable" |- ! Value !! Description |- | 0 || Setting is enabled, a chat warning will be shown requiring additional confirmation to complete the teleport. |- | 1 || Setting is disabled, no warning will be shown and the teleport will complete. |}

name: teletab_ice_plateau_warning
description: Tracks whether the in-game setting Show warning when using tablet: Ice Plateau is enabled. == Values == {| class="wikitable" |- ! Value !! Description |- | 0 || Setting is enabled, a chat warning will be shown requiring additional confirmation to complete the teleport. |- | 1 || Setting is disabled, no warning will be shown and the teleport will complete. |}

name: teletab_carrallangar_warning
description: Tracks whether the in-game setting Show warning when using tablet: Carrallanger is enabled. == Values == {| class="wikitable" |- ! Value !! Description |- | 0 || Setting is enabled, a chat warning will be shown requiring additional confirmation to complete the teleport. |- | 1 || Setting is disabled, no warning will be shown and the teleport will complete. |}

name: fairy2_queencure_quest
description: This is the main var that tracks the progress in Fairytale II - Cure a Queen. ==Values==

name: marketthief_martin
description: Set to 1 when the player has stolen from Martin the Master Gardener in Draynor Village. Martin will recognise the player when this is set to 1. Set to 0 after 1,000 consecutive ticks while logged in since seeds were last stolen from Martin.

name: gobdip_main
description: This is the main var that tracks the progress in Goblin Diplomacy. ==Values==

name: fairy2_gorak_killed
description: After starting Fairytale II - Cure a Queen and unlocking fairy rings, goraks can drop gorak claws. Upon receiving the claws as a drop the first time this varbit is set to 1 and the drop table of goraks changes to only being the gem drop table, gorak claws, and big bones. ==Values== ;0 The player has not received gorak claws as a drop from goraks yet. ;1 Upon gorak claws dropping from a gorak kill for the first time.

name: karamja_easy_count
description: Tracks how many tasks you've done for the Easy Karamja Diary.

name: lunar_quest_main
description: This is the main var that tracks the progress in Lunar Diplomacy. ==Values==

name: cert_lava_d_bones
description: Set to 0 if the player is getting noted lava dragon bones while killing lava dragons in the Wilderness. Can be toggled to 1 by talking to the Lesser Fanatic in Edgeville to get non-noted lava dragon bones instead. This can be freely toggled.

name: slayer_unlock_reddragons
description: Set to 1 when "Seeing red" is bought from the Slayer Reward Shop. While these are exposed as varbits, the client actually uses the underlying varplayers as a bitmap.

name: gargboss_unlocked_roof
description: Tracks whether the roof entrance to the Grotesque Guardians has been unlocked in the Slayer Tower with a brittle key. ==Values== ;0 Default. Locked. ;1 Unlocked with brittle key and can be entered.

name: aluft_played_before
description: Changes to 1 after agreeing to receive the training from Aluft Gianne snr. and Blurberry required to participate in the Gnome Restaurant minigame.

name: aluft_training_reward
description: Changes to 1 after completing Aluft Gianne snr.'s gnome cooking tutorial.

name: spy_armour_hint
description: Set to 1 after asking the Fortress Guards around the Black Knights' Fortress (location) what their uniform is. Set to 0 otherwise. The effect of this varbit is unknown.

name: eyeglo_quest
description: This is the main var that tracks the progress in The Eyes of Glouphrie. ==Values==

name: itdigsiteteddy
description: Set to 1 after the player has pickpocketed Teddy from the female Student at the Digsite. Set to 0 otherwise. The purpose of this varbit is unknown.

name: demonslayer_main
description: This is the main var that tracks the progress in Demon Slayer. ==Values== ; 0 : Not started. ; 1 : Set after watching the Wally cutscene and as Aris begins to say: "Delrith will come forth from the stone circle again." ; 2 : Set after talking to Sir Prysin and learning about the location of the three keys immediately following the dialogue "I gave the other to the wizard Traiborn", when the three options are seen: "Can you give me your key?", "Where can I find Captain Rovin?", and "Where does the wizard live?" ; 3 : Set after leaving the instance containing Delthrith in which he is defeated after using the correct incantation. Quest complete!

name: delrith_incantation_1
description: This is the first word in the incantation used in Demon Slayer to slay Delrith. This word is unique in the list of five. ==Values== Set to 0, the word is Carlem. Set to 1, the word is Aber. Set to 2, the word is Camerinthum. Set to 3, the word is Purchai. Set to 4, the word is Gabindo.

name: delrith_incantation_2
description: This is the second word in the incantation used in Demon Slayer to slay Delrith. This word is unique in the list of five. ==Values== Set to 0, the word is Carlem. Set to 1, the word is Aber. Set to 2, the word is Camerinthum. Set to 3, the word is Purchai. Set to 4, the word is Gabindo.

name: delrith_incantation_3
description: This is the third word in the incantation used in Demon Slayer to slay Delrith. This word is unique in the list of five. ==Values== Set to 0, the word is Carlem. Set to 1, the word is Aber. Set to 2, the word is Camerinthum. Set to 3, the word is Purchai. Set to 4, the word is Gabindo.

name: delrith_incantation_4
description: This is the fourth word in the incantation used in Demon Slayer to slay Delrith. This word is unique in the list of five. ==Values== Set to 0, the word is Carlem. Set to 1, the word is Aber. Set to 2, the word is Camerinthum. Set to 3, the word is Purchai. Set to 4, the word is Gabindo.

name: delrith_incantation_5
description: This is the fifth word in the incantation used in Demon Slayer to slay Delrith. This word is unique in the list of five. ==Values== Set to 0, the word is Carlem. Set to 1, the word is Aber. Set to 2, the word is Camerinthum. Set to 3, the word is Purchai. Set to 4, the word is Gabindo.

name: delrith_silverlight_case
description: This is set during Demon Slayer once you have all three keys. It changes the sword case from having silverlight, to being empty.

name: delrith_drain_key
description: This tracks the status of the drain for collecting Silverlight key (Sir Prysin). While destroying the key doesn't make the state go from state 2 to 1, it does happen when flushing the drain again after destroying the key. ==Values== *0 - Drain not touched *1 - Drain flushed out, key down in sewers *2 - Key taken, drain still flushed out.

name: delrith_seen_summoning_cutscene
description: Set to 1 to make the "Stone table" in the dark wizards' circle be broken. Only set during the cutscene and instance when Delrith is fought. Set to 1 when the demon breaks out of the stone table, and set back to 0 after the incantation.

name: delrith_dark_wizards_killed
description: Increments by 1 from 0 to 3 for each dark wizard killed in the instance with Delrith during Demon Slayer. This does not reset, and limits how many can be spawned in the instance should it be left and re-entered. ==Values== ; 0 : No dark wizards killed. ; 1 : 1 dark wizard killed. ; 2 : 2 dark wizards killed. ; 3 : 3 dark wizards killed. There are no more available to kill.

name: myq3_main_quest
description: This is the main var that tracks the progress in Darkness of Hallowvale. ==Values==

name: myq3_sang_punish_mining_cart
description: Set to the number of Daeyalt ore that a player has put into the Mine cart (Meiyerditch mine) in the Meiyerditch mine.

name: slug2_main
description: This is the main var that tracks the progress in The Slug Menace. ==Values==

name: slug2_npc_track1
description: When set to 0, Holgart is exclusively visible on the Fishing Platform. When set to 1, Jeb is visible instead, along with Giant lobsters.

name: elemental_quest_2_main

name: zep_quest

name: soul_wars_tutorial
description: Used in the Soul Wars demonstration for the current login session to display instructions in the chatbox (and various state changes). Leaving the demonstration early does not reset the value to 0, rather, it is reset to 0 when entering the demonstration. ==Values== ; 0 : Set when Nomad starts teleporting the player to the Soul Wars demonstration. After the cutscene, Nomad (10516) is seen at where the null NPC (10548) would be by the avatar. : A waypoint is placed on Nomad (10516). : The chatbox states Soul Wars demonstration. : Nomad's stated location changes to: I'm by the avatar in the south-west of the battleground. : Nomad's dialogue starts from: Welcome to Soul Wars! Let's get started. ; 1 : Set after Nomad teleports northwards to the supplies location, when the teleportation sound is heard. Nomad (10516) is replaced with a null NPC (10548) by the avatar in the south-west, and a null NPC (10549) is replaced with Nomad (10516) by supply area. The waypoint moves with Nomad. : The chatbox states Supplies. : Nomad's stated location changes to: I'm by the supply area in the north-west of the battleground. : Nomad's dialogue starts from: You might find this little area behind me useful for defending your avatar. There's one in the other team's base, too. ; 2 : Set after Nomad teleports to eastwards to the ruins, when the teleportation sound is heard. name: snakeboss_info
description: ==Values== ; 0 : Fishing sacred eels is not possible and will be interrupted by Zul-Onan: You know nothing of the sacred contract between our tribe and the mighty Zulrah! Ask the High Priestess to educate you about Zulrah before you meddle further. ; 1 : Set when High Priestess Zul-Harcinqa says: Willing volunteers are never hard to find, for their sacrifice buys peace for the tribe, and I grant their families extra rations of food. : Fishing sacred eels is possible and allowed. ; 2 : Set when High Priestess Zul-Harcinqa says: ... and I accept. You shall be our next sacrifice. Board the boat when you are ready, and give glory to Zulrah through your death. : Boarding the boat is possible and allowed. Priestess Zul-Gwenwynig will explain the ritual first before taking the player to Zulrah. : Changes the Sacrifice's dialogue and options: The High Priestess says you're to be the sacrifice instead of me. : Changes Zul-Urgish's dialogue: Human agreed to sacrifice himself to mighty Zulrah! We all most grateful. ; 3 : Set after Priestess Zul-Gwenwynig explains the ritual to the player and rows the player to Zulrah's shrine: The priestess rows you to Zulrah's shrine, then hurriedly paddles away. : Quick-boarding the boat no longer explains the ritual again. : Changes Priestess Zul-Gwenwynig's dialogue: You left the shrine. Did Zulrah reject your sacrifice? Speculatively also related to the "eat" option message on sacred eels. ==See also== * Transcript:Zul-Onan#Attempting to fish eels before offering yourself as a sacrifice * Transcript:High Priestess Zul-Harcinqa * Transcript:Priestess Zul-Gwenwynig
