name: deadman_protection_left
description: Counts down the remaining time until the player loses protection at the start of their account in permanent Deadman Mode worlds, with 12 hours, or 1 hour per new bracket reached in Deadman: Apocalypse. In permanent Deadman Mode worlds, protection can be removed at any time by talking to the Doomsayer.

name: wilderness_portal_choice
description: Tracks the currently selected destination for all Wilderness Obelisks and the player-owned house obelisk. ==Values== ;0 Default value. ;1 When Level 40 Wilderness is chosen. ;2 When Level 27 Wilderness is chosen. ;3 When Level 35 Wilderness is chosen. ;4 When Level 13 Wilderness is chosen. ;5 When Level 19 Wilderness is chosen. ;6 When Level 50 Wilderness is chosen.

name: slayer_unlock_lizardmen
description: Set to 1 when "Reptile got ripped" is bought from the Slayer Reward Shop. While these are exposed as varbits, the client actually uses the underlying varplayers as a bitmap.

name: mm2_progress
description: This is the main var that tracks the progress in Monkey Madness II. ==Values==

name: mm2_found_note
description: Default value 0, switches to 1 if the player has obtained the Mysterious note. Presumably switches back to 0 if the player doesn't have a Mysterious note or Scrawled note anymore. Changes the appearance of the Fire remains where the Mysterious note is obtained from, to not show the note anymore.

name: mm2_maze_return
description: Set to 1 when the shortcut to the end of Kruk's Dungeon is unlocked.

name: mm2_antias_clue
description: Defaults to 0. Set to 1 when during the Monkey Madness II quest, Anita says: "He might be in trouble, I could help.". Adds the "Climb-up" option to the Tree at Glough's house, making it possible to go from the to .

name: mm2_read_note
description: Defaults to 0. Switches to 1 after the player reads the Scrawled note for the first time. Presumably allows the player to translate the Scrawled note by using a Translation book on it, and/or changes King Narnode's dialogue to be able to receive a Translation book from him.

name: mm2_zep_gnome_pilot
description: Toggles the visibility of Assistant Le Smith at the Tree Gnome Stronghold location. Switches to 1 after unlocking the Grand Tree Balloon transport system location. Switches back to 0 when talking with King Narnode after having read the Translated note. ==Values== 0: default value, invisible. 1: visible

name: mm2_tracking_kruk
description: When switched on, it makes Tracks leading towards Jungle Grass north-west of Ape Atoll visible. It also adds a "Investigate" option to that Jungle grass, allowing the player to enter Kruk's dungeon. This happens during the Monkey Madness II quest, when asking a Monkey archer where Kruk is. ==Values== 0: Default value 1: Tracks visible, adds "Investigate" option on the Jungle grass

name: mm2_ogre_defeated
description: Switches to 1 after having defeated Keef.

name: mm2_troll_defeated
description: Switches to 1 after having defeated Kob.

name: mm2_kruk_visibility
description: Switches to 4 after the player kills Kruk. It's not clear why this varbit makes use of 2 bits instead of 1, as one of the bits seem to be unused. ==Values== 0: Default 1: Unused? 2: Kruk defeated 3: Unused?

name: mm2_slayer_master
description: Toggles the visibility of Nieve, Steve and Pieve. This happens when the player asks Nieve to help during the Monkey Madness II quest. ==Values== 0: Default value. Nieve is visible, Steve in Tree Gnome Stronghold is invisible, Steve in Asgarnian Ice Dungeon is visible, Pieve is invisible. 1: Nieve is invisible, Steve in Tree Gnome Stronghold is visible, Steve in Asgarnian Ice Dungeon is invisible, Pieve is visible.

name: mm2_nieve_at_tree
description: Toggles the visibility of Nieve right outside the Grand Tree. This happens during the Monkey Madness II quest if the player lost Nieve for some reason. Talking to her allows the player to continue the quest, making her invisible again while also spawning a new Nieve to follow the player. ==Values== 0: default value, Nieve not visible 1: Nieve visible

name: mm2_found_handkerchief
description: Adds or removes the "Investigate" option on the Tree on the of Glough's house. Investigating the Tree gives the player the Handkerchief. ==Values== 0: default value, before starting the Monkey Madness II quest, "Investigate" option not added. 1: "Investigate" option added. This only happens during the Monkey Madness II quest. Able to go 0 --> 1 by talking to King Narnode, or 2 --> 1 by going from to in Glough's house. 2: "Investigation" option removed, when finding the Handkerchief.

name: mm2_le_smith_pos
description: Determines which of the 4 Assistant Le Smith NPC's on Ape Atoll is visible. He's only visible during a part of the Monkey Madness II quest, and the specific location is random for each player. ==Values== 0: default value, none visible 1: Top floor (up two ladders) of the broken building next to the Monkey Child and The Monkey's Aunt. 2: On top of the bridge that connects the two watchtowers of the main gate. 3: Top floor of the jail 4: Top floor of the building west of the Magic Stall.

name: mm2_platform_target_1
description: Defaults at 0 if the player hasn't visited the Monkey Madness II Airship Platform yet. Switches to 1 on the first visit of the Airship Platform.

name: mm2_platform_target_2
description: Defaults to value 0. Switches to 1 after the player has placed a Satchel in the north-eastern quadrant of the of the Airship Platform.

name: mm2_platform_target_3
description: Defaults to value 0. Switches to 1 after the player has placed a Satchel on the north side of the of the Airship Platform.

name: mm2_platform_target_4
description: Defaults to value 0. Switches to 1 after the player has placed a Satchel on the east side of the of the Airship Platform.

name: mm2_platform_target_5
description: Defaults to value 0. Switches to 1 after the player has placed a Satchel on the north-western side of the of the Airship Platform.

name: mm2_platform_target_6
description: Defaults to value 0. Switches to 1 after the player has placed a Satchel on the south-eastern quadrant of the of the Airship Platform.

name: mm2_platform_targets
description: Contains all data related to Monkey Madness II's Airship Platform. Each bit corresponds to a status. These bits separately also exist as varbits.

name: arceuus_soulbearer_story
description: This is the main var that tracks the progress in Bear Your Soul. ==Values==

name: slayer_unlock_helm_black
description: Set to 1 when "King black bonnet" is bought from the Slayer Reward Shop. While these are exposed as varbits, the client actually uses the underlying varplayers as a bitmap.

name: slayer_unlock_helm_green
description: Set to 1 when "Kalphite khat" is bought from the Slayer Reward Shop. While these are exposed as varbits, the client actually uses the underlying varplayers as a bitmap.

name: slayer_unlock_helm_red

name: lovakengj_minecarts_status
description: Set to 2 if the player has paid for free Minecart usage prior to the 10 January 2024 update (Update:Children of the Sun) (and completed The Forsaken Tower quest), where Lovakengj Minecart Network carts were made free to use for players who have completed The Forsaken Tower. When 2, this initiates a dialogue with a minecart operator NPC next to the carts is talked-to: As a loyal customer of the Lovakengj Minecart Network, you're entitled to this. If the player continues the dialogue one more time, the player then receives and this value is updated to 0. May be assumed to be set to 0 for players who have not paid for free minecart access prior to the update, and may have been formerly 1 pre-update for those who had.

name: tog_countdown
description: Counts the number of ticks left for your Tears of Guthix run. Set initially to QUEST_POINTS, and goes down by 4 every 4 ticks, until it gets to 0 and you get kicked out.

name: bank_showincinerator
description: Whether or not to show the bank incinerator. Toggled in bank settings.

description: Set to 1 when the player insures the Bloodhound with Probita. Set to 0 otherwise. While these are exposed as varbits, the client actually uses the underlying varplayer 866 as a bitmap.

Cats, while able to be stored in a menagerie, are not kept with varbits – they are believed to be stored in an inventory.

name: br_ingame
description: Set to 1 while you're in a Last Man Standing game, 0 otherwise. Used to determine which runes to count towards spells.

name: wint_area_attack
description: Tracks whether the player is in the area of affect for Wintertodt. ==Values== ;0 The player is no longer within the area of effect for Wintertodt to attack. ;1 The player is inside the area of affect for Wintertodt's attacks.

name: blast_furnace_coinsincoffer
description: Value is 1 when there are coins in the Blast Furnace coffer and 0 when there are none.

name: blast_furnace_coffer
description: The value of this varbit is equal to the amount of coins in the Blast Furnace coffer. The amount of coins in the coffer drops by min(current_value, 12) every tick.

name: slayer_unlock_superiormobs
description: Set to 1 when "Bigger and Badder" is bought from the Slayer Reward Shop. While these are exposed as varbits, the client actually uses the underlying varplayers as a bitmap.

name: slayer_longer_scabarites
description: Set to 1 when "Get scabaright on it" is bought from the Slayer Reward Shop. While these are exposed as varbits, the client actually uses the underlying varplayers as a bitmap.

name: pet_insurance_phoenixpet
description: Set to 1 when the player insures Phoenix. Set to 0 otherwise. While this is exposed as a single-bit varbit, the client actually uses varbit 2168 instead as a bitmap. Both varbits come from the same varplayer 1417.

name: bank_hidedepositworn
description: Whether or not to hide the 'deposit worn items' button. Toggled in bank settings, although the toggle is actually to show it (default on).

name: rc_zmi_lunar_spell

An optional reward from the Lunar Diplomacy quest. ==Values== ; 0 : Ourania Teleport cannot be cast (and Ourania teleport tablets cannot be broken), and guides the player to talk to Baba Yaga after completing the Lunar Diplomacy quest. : Baba Yaga has a chat option about the spell (after completing the Lunar Diplomacy quest). ; 1 : The player has finished listening to Baba Yaga's story and continued after her last line of dialogue: And now you know the teleportation spell, off with you! Go explore. : Ourania Teleport and the tablet can be cast/broken. : Baba Yaga's chat option about the spell is removed. ==Trivia== * Auto-completing the Lunar Diplomacy quest with Sage's Renown in the Shattered Relics League does not automatically unlock the Ourania Teleport spell. Players must talk to Baba Yaga to unlock it, as usual.

name: option_dropwarning_on
description: Tracks whether the in-game setting Drop item warning is enabled. == Values == {| class="wikitable" |- ! Value !! Description |- | 0 || Setting is disabled, any valued item can be dropped as normal. |- | 1 || Setting is enabled, dropping an item with a higher value than the set threshold, will cause a chat warning requiring additional confirmation, to appear. (See RuneScape:Varbit/5412) |}

name: option_dropwarning_value
description: Tracks the set minimum item value needed for a drop item warning. See Runescape:Varbit/5411

name: raids_guide_travel_unlock
description: Makes the Mountain Guide visible at his Shayzien's wall location, with a 'Travel' option.

name: raids_client_partysize
description: Tracks the size of your raids party, once the raid has started. The number is displayed in the Raids HUD. Resets upon leaving a raid.

name: raids_client_progress
description: Tracks your party's status during a raid. Used to display a status in the HUD. ==Values== *0 - Waiting for your leader to begin the raid... *1 - Your party is exploring the upper level... *2 (mostly - needs some confirmation) - Your party has reached the middle level... *3 - Your party has reached the lower level... *4 - Your party has reached the bottom... *5 (after defeating Great Olm) - Get out! Get out! GET OUT!

name: raids_client_indungeon
description: Set to 1 while you are in a raid. Set to 0 when the raid ends. Controls, among other things, whether the minigames tab is replaced with the raids tab.

name: pet_insurance_olmpet
description: Set to 1 when the player insures Olmlet. Set to 0 otherwise. While this is exposed as a single-bit varbit, the client actually uses varbit 2168 instead as a bitmap. Both varbits come from the same varplayer 1417.

name: pet_menagerie_olm
description: Set to 1 when the Olmlet is put into a menagerie, and set to 0 when taken out. While these are exposed as varbits, the client actually uses the underlying varplayers as a bitmap. Cats, while able to be stored in a menagerie, are not kept with varbits – they are believed to be stored in an inventory.

name: prayer_rigour_unlocked

name: prayer_rigour

name: prayer_augury

name: prayer_preserve

name: motherlode_biggersack

name: motherlode_sack_transmit
description: The amount of pay-dirt in the Motherlode Mine sack. This value is show in the HUD. This varbit also controls the sack multiobject, which becomes the empty sack when the value is 0 and the sack when the value is non-zero. Although this varbit can theoretically take on the values 0 to 255, this is capped at either 108 with the regular sack or 189 with the upgraded sack.

name: inferno_sacrificed_firecape
description: Tracks if the player has received permission from TzHaar-Ket to enter the inner area of Mor Ul Rek. ==Values== ; 0 : No permission to enter the inner area of the TzHaar city, the player's attempt to pass the Hot vent door starts dialogue with a TzHaar-Ket guard. ; 1 : Set when TzHaar-Ket grants access (by showing a fire cape): I suppose so, I'll grant you access to Mor Ul Rek. name: pest_activity_counter
description: Tracks your activity meter in Pest Control (see the article for more details). Starts at 25, maxes out at 50. Activity bar is displayed in the HUD for Pest Control.

name: take_ammo_toggle
description: Tracks whether the in-game setting Ammo-picking behaviour is enabled. == Values == {| class="wikitable" |- ! Value !! name: hosidiusquest
description: This tracks progress in The Depths of Despair. ==Values== ;0 Quest not started. ;1 After the player says they will help Lord Hosidius. ;2 After speaking to Chef Olivia and tells the player Artur has been spending time at the Arceuus library and mentions Galena. ;3 Once Galena tells the player to read The Envoy of Varlamore. ;4 Upon opening The Envoy of Varlamore to read it. ;5 Optional step. Once Hugor tells the player there is a big set of caves east of him. ;6 As the player enters the crabclaw cave. ;7 As the player enters the tunnel entrance/ ;8 After the player tells Artur that they will kill the snake. ;9 Upon defeating the sand snake. ;10 After searching the chest and obtaining the royal accord. ;11 After delivering the royal accord to Lord Hosidius. Quest complete.

name: fixedlandinglights
description: Each bit in this var tracks whether one of the 8 gnome landing lights has been repaired with a cut gem during One Small Favour. ==Values== At the start, this varbit is set to 0, and repairing each light with a gem will set the corresponding bit. Once all the lights have been repaired, the varbit will have reached its maximum value of 255. As an example, repairing the north strip of lights will result in a varbit value of 15, the sum of 1, 2, 4, and 8. {|class=wikitable !Bit !Light |- |0 |North jade |- |1 |North red topaz |- |2 |North opal |- |3 |North sapphire |- |4 |South jade |- |5 |South red topaz |- |6 |South opal |- |7 |South sapphire |}

name: farming_tools_extra2buckets
description: The amount of buckets in your Tool Leprechaun is equal to 256 * varbit 6265 + 32 * varbit 4731 + varbit 1441, maxing out at 1000 total. This was presumably done so that the maximum quantity could be increased to 1000 (previous maximums unknown), but without changing/migrating the original varbit that was used to store it. This was done to nearly every item in the tool storage, but buckets are unique in that the maximum was resized twice, and thus use 3 distinct varbits.

name: poh_nexus_tele_16
description: Tracks which teleport is stored in slot #16 of the Portal Nexus. It's set on login and only changes if the slot is changed in the Portal Nexus configuration, at which point varbit 6568 (the interface version) is copied to it. The values correspond to [https://chisel.weirdgloop.org/structs/index.html?type=enums&id=1377 enum 1377]. Note that the values of 150+ (corresponding to switches between e.g. Varrock/Grand Exchange) are not set on this varbit – it will always refer to the base teleport.

name: karam_dungeon_doordata
description: This varbit is composed of four bits. The ones place bit is set to 1 when the player has paid Saniboch for access to Brimhaven Dungeon and is flipped back to 0 upon entering or paying the permanent fee. The twos place bit is set to 1 when the player has paid Banisoch for access to the Brimhaven dungeon, and is not set back to 0 until Banisoch's warning for entering the caves has been disabled. The fours place bit is set to 1 when this warning is disabled. The eights place bit is set to 1 once the player has paid Saniboch one million coins for permanent access to the dungeon. ==Values== *0 - No access to either Saniboch or Banisoch's entrance *1 - One-time access to Saniboch's entrance *2 - Access to Banisoch's entrance only, with the warning still enabled *3 - One-time access to Saniboch's entrance and access to Banisoch's entrance, with the warning still enabled *4 - Access to Banisoch's entrance only, with the warning disabled *5 - One-time access to Saniboch's entrance and access to Banisoch's entrance, with the warning disabled *6 - Impossible state *7 - Impossible state *8 - Permanent access to Saniboch's entrance only *9 - Impossible state *10 - Permanent access to Saniboch's entrance and access to Banisoch's entrance, with the warning still enabled *11 - Impossible state *12 - Permanent access to Saniboch's entrance and access to Banisoch's entrance, with the warning disabled *13 - Impossible state *14 - Impossible state *15 - Impossible state

description: Set to 0 if the Twisted League master task "Equip a Golden Tench" is incomplete. Set to 1 once the task is completed. It is only set on Leagues worlds, and could be re-used in future leagues (if the task is re-used), where it would be reset to 0.

name: league_type
description: Tracks if the player is currently playing on one of the Leagues worlds. == Values == {| class="wikitable" |- ! Value !! Description |- | 0 || The player is not playing on a leagues world. |- | 4 || The player is playing on a Leagues IV world. |- | 5 || The player is playing on a Leagues V world. |}

name: league_task_filter_tier
description: Value indicates the current "Tier" filter value on the Trailblazer League tasks interface. ==Values== *0 - All *1 - Easy *2 - Medium *3 - Hard *4 - Elite *5 - Master

name: league_task_filter_completed
description: Value indicates the current "Completed" filter value on the Trailblazer League tasks interface. ==Values== *0 - All *1 - Incomplete *2 - Complete

name: league_grubby_chest_counter
description: Tracks how many times player has opened the Grubby Chest. Starts at 0 and increases by one for every Grubby key used to unlock the chest. The value is displayed in the chat with the "Check" option. Introduced with 13 January 2021 update (Update:God Wars Instancing and Soul Wars Improvements). The number of chests opened prior to that update is not tracked.

name: league_artefacts_stolen
description: Tracks how many times player has delivered an artefact to Captain Khaled. Starts at 0 and increases by one for each artefact delivered.

name: league_total_tasks_completed
description: Tracks how many tasks the player has completed during the current Leagues.

name: league_chambers_uniques
description: Set to 1 after talking to a pickpocketable vyre once the vyre says "Ah, the one that runs it must also be a vyre of culture." about Tithe Farm. This dialogue tree starts with "Hey. Anything interesting going on around here?" This modifies Farmer Gricoller's dialogue options to include "Life seems peaceful here."

name: league_relic_last_viewed
description: Value indicates the last relic viewed in the Trailblazer League relics interface. Defaults to 0 on login. ==Values== *0 - Endless Harvest *1 - Production Master *2 - Skilling Prodigy *3 - Fairy's Flight *4 - Eternal Jeweller *5 - Last Recall *6 - Quick Shot *7 - Fluid Strikes *8 - Double Cast *9 - Treasure Seeker *10 - Unnatural Selection *11 - The Botanist *12 - Infernal Gathering *13 - Equilibrium *14 - Draining Strikes *15 - Exploding Attacks *16 - Weapon Specialist

name: league_relic_selection_2

It's set on login and only changes if the slot is changed in the Portal Nexus configuration, at which point varbit 10092 (the interface version) is copied to it. Note that the values of 150+ (corresponding to switches between e.g. Varrock/Grand Exchange) are not set on this varbit – it will always refer to the base teleport.

name: slayer_unlock_helm_twisted
description: Set to 1 when "Twisted Vision" is bought from the Slayer Reward Shop. While these are exposed as varbits, the client actually uses the underlying varplayers as a bitmap.

name: pet_menagerie_nightmare
description: Set to 1 when the Little nightmare is put into a menagerie, and set to 0 when taken out. While these are exposed as varbits, the client actually uses the underlying varplayers as a bitmap. Cats, while able to be stored in a menagerie, are not kept with varbits – they are believed to be stored in an inventory.

name: pet_insurance_nightmare
description: Set to 1 when the player insures Little nightmare. Set to 0 otherwise. While this is exposed as a single-bit varbit, the client actually uses varbit 2168 instead as a bitmap. Both varbits come from the same varplayer 1417.

name: hnt_hint_step
description: Which screen of the bank tutorial you are on (zero-indexed). Can go back and forth.

name: bank_hidebanktut
description: Whether or not to show the bank tutorial. Toggled in bank settings.

name: slayer_unlock_vampyres
description: Set to 1 when "Actual Vampyre Slayer" is bought from the Slayer Reward Shop. While these are exposed as varbits, the client actually uses the underlying varplayers as a bitmap.

name: slayer_longer_vampyres
description: Set to 1 when "More at stake" is bought from the Slayer Reward Shop. While these are exposed as varbits, the client actually uses the underlying varplayers as a bitmap.

name: hallowed_time_remaining
description: Countdown timer for the Hallowed Sepulchre.

name: hallowed_ghost_owlknight_visible
description: Enabled after talking to Knight of the Owl on the first floor of Hallowed Sepulchre. When enabled, he will appear in the lobby.

name: hallowed_ghost_lionknight_visible
description: Enabled after talking to Knight of the Lion on the second floor of Hallowed Sepulchre. When enabled, he will appear in the lobby.

name: hallowed_ghost_wolfknight_visible
description: Enabled after talking to Knight of the Wolf on the third floor of Hallowed Sepulchre. When enabled, he will appear in the lobby.

name: hallowed_ghost_unicornknight_visible
description: Enabled after talking to Knight of the Unicorn on the fourth floor of Hallowed Sepulchre. When enabled, he will appear in the lobby.

name: hallowed_ghost_archpriest_visible
description: Enabled after talking to Archpriest of the Unicorn on the fifth floor of Hallowed Sepulchre. When enabled, he will appear in the lobby.

name: hallowed_tutorial
description: Enabled after talking to the Mysterious Stranger in the Hallowed Sepulchre lobby. When enabled, the 'Exchange' and 'Shop' options appear in his menu.

name: hallowed_adventurer_floor1_west
description: Paid the Darkmeyer Slave 100 Hallowed Marks for his freedom.

name: hallowed_normal_chest_count
description: Stores the number of completed Trailblazer League tasks.

name: gravestone_duration
description: Tracks how many ticks your gravestone has left. Starts at 1500 and goes down by 3 every 3 ticks. Can sometimes go from 1500 to 1501 for unknown reasons.

name: canoestation_state_sanctuary
description: Tracks the state of building a canoe at the station in Ferox Enclave. Changes depending on you cutting the tree, shaping the canoe, and pushing the canoe in the water. ==Values== *0 - Tree Upright *1 - Log Land *2 - Dugout Land *3 - Stable Land *4 - Waka Land *5 - Log Falling *6 - Dugout Falling *7 - Stable Falling *8 - Waka Falling *9 - Tree Falling *10 - Tree Fallen *11 - Log Water *12 - Dugout Water *13 - Stable Water *14 - Waka Water

name: wildy_hub_buffer
description: Set to 1 while you are in the "safe zone" around Ferox Enclave. This is the area where you can be attacked if you're teleblocked.

name: worn_items_set_text
description: Shows which set bonus you currently have active. Indexes into [https://chisel.weirdgloop.org/structs/index.html?type=enums&id=3047 enum 3047]. Seems to only update while the worn equipment screen or bank is open.

name: worn_items_graceful_hood
description: Set to 1 if you're wearing a graceful hood of any type. Only seems to be modified when the equipment or bank interface is open. Used to display set bonuses in the Worn Equipment interface.

name: worn_items_graceful_torso

name: worn_items_graceful_legs
description: Set to 1 if you're wearing graceful legs of any type. Only seems to be modified when the equipment or bank interface is open. Used to display set bonuses in the Worn Equipment interface.

name: worn_items_graceful_boots

name: worn_items_graceful_gloves

name: worn_items_graceful_cape
description: Set to 1 if you're wearing a graceful cape of any type. Only seems to be modified when the equipment or bank interface is open. Used to display set bonuses in the Worn Equipment interface.

name: worn_items_graceful_set
description: Counts how many graceful outfit pieces you're wearing. Only seems to be set when the equipment or bank interface is open. Used to display set bonuses in the Worn Equipment interface.

name: xmas20_tracker
description: This varbit keeps track of the player's progress during 2020 Christmas event. ==Values== * 0 - The player has not started participating in the event by talking to Scrubfoot. Scrubfoot at Goblin Village is busy scrubbing the generals' feet. During the event, Scrubfoot can be seen near the festive tree. General Bentnoze and General Wartface don't have event dialogue or an option to talk about Christmas. Grubfoot's dialogue is always festive. * 1 - The player will remember where the conversation with Scrubfoot left off near the festive tree. At Goblin Village, Scrubfoot starts saying to be in trouble with the generals. Set when Scrubfoot exclaims: Scrubfoot on mission for General Wartface and General Bentnoze. * 2 - The player will remember where the conversation with Scrubfoot left off near the festive tree. Set when Scrubfoot exclaims: Yes. Scrubfoot small so the humans no see Scrubfoot spying. * 3 - The player will remember where the conversation with Scrubfoot left off near the festive tree. Set when Scrubfoot exclaims: Yes. Goblins hear humans have Christmas. Christmas good. Goblins take it from humans. * 4 - N/A (not seen, skips from 3 to 5 in Scrubfoot's dialogue) * 5 - The goblin generals get a Talk about Christmas. dialogue option. Near the festive tree, Scrubfoot will remind to the player of what Scrubfoot was not meant to say about the Goblin Village. Set when the player exclaims to Scrubfoot: Goblin Village you say? I better head up there.. * 6 - Scrubfoot disappears from the tree location. Scrubfoot's dialogue returns to being busy scrubbing the generals' feet. Set after General Bentnoze exclaims to the player: Silly human! and when options are seen. * 7 - The player will remember where the conversation with the goblin generals left off. Talking to the generals about Christmas now continues from these If you know Christmas so well... and What's your favourite thing about Christmas? options (followed by a selectable option You don't know anything about Christmas, do you?). Set after General Bentnoze exclaims: Christmas good. when options are seen. * 8 - The player will remember where the conversation with the goblin generals left off. After selecting the You don't know anything about Christmas, do you? option, Talk about Christmas. will continue the conversation from this point. Set when the player exclaims You don't know anything about Christmas, do you? * 9 - N/A (not seen, skips from 8 to 10 in the generals' dialogue) * 10 - The player will remember where the conversation with the goblin generals left off. Talk about Christmas. will continue the conversation with the goblin generals from those four discussion topics, and those discussion topics continue from similar vars. If the player has given fireflies to the generals (RS:Varbit/11726) and until the player has not finished the event and claimed rewards (value 15), the chatbox at the end of the sled race will state: Maybe after helping the goblins you can sled more and track how fast you race. Set after the player exclaims to the generals to promise to teach about Christmas: Sigh. Guess it's worth a try. and when the four festive discussion options are seen. * 11 - Concurrently this value is updated with RS:Varbit/11724 after the boulder is rolled down the cliff to the village. (Makes it so the stick cannot be picked up again, and the undecorated potato-like boulder appears in the village.) * 12 - The player will remember where the conversation with the goblin generals left off. The boulder in the centre of the goblin village is replaced with a decorated boulder (different ID, with a different inspection text). Set when the player has finished all four festive tasks (all of RS:Varbit/11724, RS:Varbit/11725, RS:Varbit/11726 and RS:Varbit/11727 with a value of 3) and exclaims: I think I've taught you everything I can about Christmas. How do you feel about it now? * 13 - N/A (not seen, skips from 12 to 14 in the same dialogue with the generals) * 14 - The player will remember where the conversation with the goblin generals left off. Rewards unclaimed but the event (practically) completed. Set when the player exclaims: Thanks, you two. I appreciate it. If the player doesn't continue to the next dialogue or is ineligible for rewards, Talk about Christmas. will continue from: Hi again. Do you have anything for me for helping you out with Christmas?. New accounts (< 24 hours old real-time) may be prevented getting the rewards and progressing to value 15, depending on date of the event. * 15 - Rewards claimed and event completed. Requires eligibility for rewards. During the event, sled racing started tracking the best times. After the event, sled racing started tracking times nonetheless. The goblin generals change their dialogue slightly to Are you still enjoying Christmas? discussion.

name: xmas20_boulder
description: This varbit keeps track of the player's progress of teaching about trees during 2020 Christmas event. ==Values== * 0 - The player has not talked to the goblin generals about trees. The player can't interact with the boulder and the stick. * 1 - The player can go pick up the stick and push the boulder. Changes the goblin generals' subsequent dialogue slightly when talking about trees. Set when the player talks to the goblin generals about trees for the first time: While I highly doubt that, I will go take a look at this boulder. * 2 - The player has pushed the boulder down to the village. Changes the goblin generals' subsequent dialogue slightly when talking about trees. The stick on the ground no longer has an option to pick one up, and there is no more boulder on top of the hill. The player's stick is also destroyed. Set when: The boulder rolls down the hill, into the village. One goblin barely dodges it as it rolls past. RS:Varbit/11718 value is concurrently updated to 11. * 3 - The player has talked to the goblin generals about trees and the task is done. Changes the goblin generals' subsequent dialogue slightly when talking about trees (unless the player has completed all four tasks, in which case the updated dialogue can't be seen). Required to progress RS:Varbit/11718 further (along with other tasks: RS:Varbit/11725, RS:Varbit/11726 and RS:Varbit/11727). Set when the player exclaims: Glad I could help.

name: xmas20_gifts
description: This varbit keeps track of the player's progress of teaching about gifts during 2020 Christmas event. ==Values== * 0 - The player has not talked to the goblin generals about gifts. There is nothing of interest in the Treasure chest. * 1 - Changes the goblin generals' subsequent dialogue slightly when talking about gifts. General Wartface expresses sadness, and General Bentnoze suggests maybe goblins should invade after all. Searching the Treasure chest prompts to pick three gift items. Set when the player talks to the goblin generals about gifts for the first time when General Wartface exclaims: Hurry up, human! Me wants gift now. * 2 - Changes the goblin generals' subsequent dialogue slightly when talking about gifts. General Wartface and General Bentnoze shut up (omit their two lines) about sadness and invasion when talking about gifts. Searching the Treasure skips picking gift picking interface and tries to give the player Goblin gifts. Set when the player has picked 3 items that goblins like from the Treasure chest (when RS:Varbit/11730 value is 3): That should be good enough for the goblin generals. I hope they will like what I got them. or That's all of them. I don't have space in my inventory for the gifts though. I should come back with more space. depending on inventory space. * 3 - The player has talked to the goblin generals about gifts and the task is done. Changes the goblin generals' subsequent dialogue slightly when talking about gifts (unless the player has completed all four tasks, in which case the updated dialogue can't be seen). Required to progress RS:Varbit/11718 further (along with other tasks: RS:Varbit/11724, RS:Varbit/11726 and RS:Varbit/11727). There is nothing of interest in the Treasure chest. Set when the player exclaims: Yes, I have them here.

name: xmas20_sled
description: This varbit keeps track of the player's progress of teaching about decorations during 2020 Christmas event. ==Values== * 0 - The player has not talked to the goblin generals about decorations. The cave smells funny and the player would rather not go there, preventing access to the sled racing cave. Scrubfoot may be seen at Goblin Village. * 1 - The player is now willing to enter the cave to get "glowy lights" from the sled racing cave for the goblin generals. Changes the goblin generals' subsequent dialogue slightly when talking about decorations. Scrubfoot becomes invisible at the Goblin Village (runs off into the cave, crashed into a wall at the end). Used to track if the player has said/seen a dialogue after entering the cave for the first time. Set when General Wartface exclaims: It too late! Scrubfoot already gone. * 2 - Allows the player to catch green and red fireflies. The sledding time is counted in-game in ticks, but not tracked by the game and no message about the player's time is displayed when jumping the slope end. Set when the player exclaims after entering the cave for the first time: Scrubfoot must have passed through here. Subsequently this message is not displayed again (and in any case not after the 2020 Christmas event ended). * 3 - The player has talked to the goblin generals about decorations, handed both coloured fireflies to them and the task is done. Changes the goblin generals' subsequent dialogue slightly when talking about decorations (unless the player has completed all four tasks, in which case the updated dialogue can't be seen). Required to progress RS:Varbit/11718 further (along with other tasks: RS:Varbit/11724, RS:Varbit/11725 and RS:Varbit/11727). During the event if RS:Varbit/11718 value is < 15 (the player hasn't claimed rewards) and this value is 3, jumping the slope end displays a message: Maybe after helping the goblins you can sled more and track how fast you race. If RS:Varbit/11718 value is 15 (and in any case after the 2020 Christmas event ended), the sled racing slope tracks and displays the player's best time. When this value is 3, fireflies no longer have an option to catch from the cave (and in any case not after the 2020 Christmas event ended). Set when General Bentnoze exclaims: It not all green so General Wartface not happy. It OK with me. We get more red glowy things later.

name: xmas20_food
description: This varbit keeps track of the player's progress of teaching about food during 2020 Christmas event. ==Values== * 0 - The player has not talked to the goblin generals about food. The Goblin Cook (Mudknuckles) has non-event dialogue. The cauldron in the kitchen has no event interaction. * 1 - The Goblin Cook says the player can search the kitchen for ingredients and use the cauldron. Changes the goblin generals' subsequent dialogue slightly when talking about food. Set when the player exclaims: Eyes, cream. I see. I'll have a look in the kitchens and see if I can find anything to cook for you. * 2 - The player has finished cooking the stew by placing all three ingredients to the cauldron. Changes the goblin generals' subsequent dialogue slightly when talking about food, if the player destroyed the Goblin stew and left it stew in the cauldron, telling the player has finished cooking. The shelves, sacks and cupboards no longer have a search option in the kitchen. The Goblin Cook's event dialogue changes offering to try the stew; subsequently after the Goblin Cook has tasted the stew (if RS:Varbit/11733 value is also 1), the Goblin Cook will tell the player to not wait any longer and take the stew to the generals. Set when the player exclaims: Yuck, this food smells terrible! Hopefully this should do it. I need to bring this back to the generals. * 3 - The player has talked to the goblin generals about food, handed Goblin stew to them and the task is done. The player cannot acquire more Goblin stew from the cauldron, it doesn't have more event interaction. Changes the goblin generals' subsequent dialogue slightly when talking about trees (unless the player has completed all four tasks, in which case the updated dialogue can't be seen). The Goblin Cook's dialogue changes slightly him desiring more of the stew and needing the recipe. Required to progress RS:Varbit/11718 further (along with other tasks: RS:Varbit/11724, RS:Varbit/11725 and RS:Varbit/11726). Set when the player exclaims: I did! Here you go, have a taste.

name: xmas20_ingredients
description: This varbit keeps track which ingredients have been placed into the cauldron during 2020 Christmas event's section where the player cooks Goblin stew in the goblin kitchen for the goblin generals. Once an item has been placed into the cauldron, the player doesn't want to take more of that item from the shelves, sacks or cupboards and leaves them be. If the player has all three ingredients in their inventory, the typical order is 0 → 2 → 3 → 7 and is not dependent on inventory item order. ==Values== * 0 - There are no ingredients in the cauldron. All shelves, sacks and cupboards yield ingredients. * 1 - Mouldy sawdust has been placed into the cauldron. * 2 - Rotten meat has been placed into the cauldron. * 3 - Mouldy sawdust and Rotten meat has been placed into the cauldron. * 4 - Stale bread has been placed into the cauldron. * 5 - Mouldy sawdust and Stale bread has been placed into the cauldron. * 6 - Rotten meat and Stale bread has been placed into the cauldron. * 7 - All three ingredients have been placed into the cauldron. RS:Varbit/11727 is unchanged until the next dialogue: Yuck, this food smells terrible! Hopefully this should do it. I need to bring this back to the generals.

name: xmas20_odd
description: This varbit keeps track of the correct Treasure chest interface's gift during 2020 Christmas event. Third-party clients may read this varbit's values to highlight or select the correct gift to the user. ==Values== When RS:Varbit/11725 value is 1, searching the Treasure chest at Goblin Village prompts the player to pick three gifts for the goblin generals. Three gift options are shown rotating in the interface: One is correct and the other two are incorrect. The value is updated whenever the gifts interface is opened (spinning/rotating gifts). The value may not change depending on randomness, if the correct gift location happens to randomly pick the same position as previously. * 0 - The left item is the correct one * 1 - The middle item is the correct one * 2 - The right item is the correct one

name: xmas20_correct
description: This varbit keeps track of the number of correct gifts picked from the Treasure chest during 2020 Christmas event. The player needs to pick three correct gift items from the Treasure chest to receive Goblin gifts. ==Values== Ranges from 0 to 3 (starting at 0). Each correct gift picked is followed by the player's exclamation That seems like a good goblin gift. I should get some more. and increases this varbit's value by one. No penalty if an incorrect gift is picked followed by the player's exclamation That doesn't seem like the best gift for a goblin. At value 3, the player's exclamation That seems like a good goblin gift. I should get some more. is replaced with That should be good enough for the goblin generals. I hope they will like what I got them. or That's all of them. I don't have space in my inventory for the gifts though. I should come back with more space., depending on available inventory space. RS:Varbit/11725 changes value from 1 to 2.

name: xmas20_time
description: This varbit counts the player's sled racing time during and after 2020 Christmas event. The counter starts from 0 and counts up by one every tick every time the player starts sledding down the slope. The counter stops when the player starts jumping the slope end. The time is then converted from ticks to a human-readable current sled racing time and displayed in the game chat. Since the 22 December 2020 update, the best time is saved to the player's save profile in RS:Varbit/11732.

name: xmas20_time_pb
description: This varbit counts the player's personal best sled racing time during and after 2020 Christmas event. Introduced / made functional in the 22 December 2020 update. Prior to 22 December 2020, this variable was not saved or updated. RS:Varbit/11731 counter starts from 0 and counts up by one every tick every time the player starts sledding down the slope. The counter stops when the player starts jumping the slope end. If that time was the player's best time, the time is then converted from ticks to a human-readable current sled racing time, displayed in the game chat and stored into this varbit. ==2021 Easter event== During the 2021 Easter event introduction between the player and Gregg (RS:Varbit/11951 value is exactly 0), Gregg mentions the goblins kept their "stupid sled track from Christmas!" When this varbit's (11732) value is > 0 (the player has a personal best time on the sled track), the player exclaims the sled racing being "fun". Gregg then responds to have tried it himself, but he was mobbed by goblings about Easter eggs and told the goblins they would have wait until Easter for easter eggs.

name: xmas20_cook
description: Defaults to 0. Set to 1 if the Goblin Cook has tasted the Goblin stew during 2020 Christmas event, which changes his dialogue slightly when using the Goblin stew on him again. What human waiting for? Bring food to generals before they beat Mudknuckles!

name: shades_dampe_intro
description: Set to 1 after the player meets Dampe and acquires a coffin from him. This alters Dampe's dialogue.

name: shades_swamp_unlock
description: Set to 1 after the player consumes a Runescroll of swampbark, otherwise 0. When 1, allows to infuse Splitbark armour with Nature runes at a Nature altar to create Swampbark armour. The text on runescrolls of swampbark will be changed, stating the player already has the knowledge to infuse Splitbark armour with Nature runes.

name: shades_blood_unlock
description: Set to 1 after the player consumes a Runescroll of bloodbark, otherwise 0. When 1, allows to infuse Splitbark armour with Blood runes at a Blood altar to create Bloodbark armour. The text on runescrolls of bloodbark will be changed, stating the player already has the knowledge to infuse Splitbark armour with Blood runes.

name: osb8_knife_received
description: If the player has not borrowed a knife from Zeke in the 2021 Birthday event, Zeke will offer to borrow the player his knife. This tracks if Zeke has given the player a knife. Zeke will first check if the player has a knife in their inventory, then if the player's inventory is full, and finally if there is inventory space and the player doesn't have a knife in inventory, he gives the player a knife. Set from 0 to 1 when Zeke hands you a knife., after which Zeke will remember to have given the player his knife and will subsequently change his dialogue to guide the player to buy one from Lumbridge general store. Any knives are not checked from the player's inventory again. After 17 March 2021, the 2021 Birthday event dialogue was removed from Zeke and this varbit does nothing effectively.

name: osb8_luthas_discussed
description: In the 2021 Birthday event, if the player asks Zeke Where did you get premium bananas?, he tells he gets his premium bananas from Luthas. This may introduce a new dialogue option with Luthas. * If RS:Varbit/11833 value is ≥ 20 and ≤ 35 and the player finishing this dialogue with Zeke until other options are seen, this varbit's value is set from 0 to 1. If the player interrupts the dialogue with Zeke, this value is unchanged. * If RS:Varbit/11833's value is ≥ 40, this value cannot be incremented to 1. Where did you get premium bananas? will be available, but will not change this value. This coincides with Zeke's new behaviour at ≥ 40, which removes two other dialogue options. Although the player implies in the dialogue with Zeke the player has knowledge about Luthas, the player does not need to have met Luthas or accepted his task before. This varbit's value and Luthas' additional dialogue option persists after the 2021 Birthday event was removed on 17 March 2021. ==Values== ; 0 : Luthas' dialogue option Do you know of a man called Zeke? will be unavailable. ; 1 : Luthas' dialogue option Do you know of a man called Zeke? will be available.

This tracks if Duke has given the coins to the player. Set from 0 to 1 when The Duke hands you some coins., after which Duke will not give the player coins again. For players which have completed Prince Ali Rescue before claiming the coins from Duke, it is impossible to increment this varbit's value to 1.

name: easter21_sheepcount
description: Counts how much "fresh" wool the player has acquired while tasked by Gregg to shear three sheep for "fresh" wool, while the 2021 Easter event is active. ==Rules and behaviour== For each sheep sheared, this varbit's value may increment by one with the following rules: * If RS:Varbit/11951 value is ≤ 50 (the player is not tasked to shear the sheep), this counter does not increment. * If RS:Varbit/11951 value is ≥ 51 (the player has agreed to shear sheep), this counter can increment up to 3. Every time Gregg is given "fresh" wool (use wool on Gregg, or talk-to Gregg) while he's looking for pieces of wool, up to X available wool is removed from the player's inventory, where X is this counter's value. For each wool removed this way, this counter's value is decremented by X amount. If RS:Varbit/11951 is 51, it will be first set to 52. For each wool removed this way, RS:Varbit/11951 will be incremented by X pieces of removed, up to the remaining (3/2/1) pieces of wool needed, until RS:Varbit/11951 reaches value 55. If the player's inventory is full while shearing the sheep, the value will still be incremented according to rules above. The wool from the sheep will be placed on the ground this way. The wool acquired from sheep is regular wool (item ID 1737) for all intents and purposes, not any kind of special Easter event wool with a different item ID. Dropping wool from the player's inventory does not decrement this counter's value. If this counter's value is 0 and if the player has wool in their inventory, Gregg will exclaim the wool is not fresh: Human, I don't think that wool is fresh. Attempting to shear The Thing will not increment this counter. The sheep do not have to be sheared at the Lumbridge sheep pen. ==Examples== * The player's inventory has 0 pieces of wool. Gregg is still looking for more pieces of wool. The counter's value is ignored. Gregg's dialogue will have options to talk about. * The player's inventory has 1 piece of wool. The counter's value is 0. If Gregg is still looking for pieces of wool, Gregg will exclaim the wool is not fresh. Alternatively if Gregg already has the three pieces of wool, he will decline the wool. In both scenarios, the player keeps the wool. * The player's inventory has 2 pieces of wool. The counter's value is 1. Gregg has 0 pieces of wool. The player hands over Gregg one wool, one wool is removed from the player's inventory, RS:Varbit/11951 is set to 52 + 1 = 53, and this counter is decremented by one (set to 0). * The player's inventory has 2 pieces of wool. The counter's value is 3. Gregg has 0 pieces of wool. The player hands over Gregg two wools, two wools are removed from the player's inventory, RS:Varbit/11951 is set to 52 + 2 = 54, and this counter is decremented by two (set to 1). * The player's inventory has 3 pieces of wool. The counter's value is 2. Gregg has 0 pieces of wool. The player hands over Gregg two wools, two wools are removed from the player's inventory, RS:Varbit/11951 is set to 52 + 2 = 54, and this counter is decremented by two (set to 0). The player keeps one "non-fresh" wool in the inventory, which can be considered "fresh" if the player shears one more sheep later. * The player's inventory has 4 pieces of wool. The counter's value is 3. Gregg has 0 pieces of wool. The player hands over Gregg three wools, three wools are removed from the player's inventory, RS:Varbit/11951 is set to 52 + 3 = 55, and this counter is decremented by three (set to 0). The player keeps one wool in their inventory as excess. * The player's inventory has 2 pieces of wool. The counter's value is 1. Gregg has 2 pieces of wool. The player shears three more sheep: the counter's value is increased to 3, to its maximum value (not 4). The player hands over Gregg the last piece of wool, one piece of wool is removed from the player's inventory, RS:Varbit/11951 is set to 54 + 1 = 55, and this counter is decremented by one (set to 2). The player keeps excess wool in their inventory, if the player had any. * The player has completed the 2021 Easter event. The counter's value is 0. The player can increment the counter up to 3 by shearing three sheep.

name: hw21_iffie_scene_stage
description: Associated with various hacks to make the 2021 Halloween event play smoother for the player. Values are 0–2 inclusive. 0 and 1 are used in a Blue Moon Inn cutscene with a likely theory. 2 is used in a cinematic action scene south of the Edgeville Monastery, with uncertain but many plausibilities. ==Changes at The Blue Moon Inn== Set 0 at the start of the Blue Moon Inn cutscene featuring the cook. Set to 1 when the Cook (2021 Halloween event) (11251) says: Leaving and interrupting the cutscene won't switch the value back to 0. This is somewhat coincidentally timed with Iffie (11245) with the stool being removed from the scene off-camera and a walking Iffie (11246) being spawned somewhere off-camera (or replacing Iffie (11245)). In the cutscene the stools the player and Iffie are sitting on during the cutscene are not actually game objects, but part of the 3D model or worn equipment (likely Stool (25711) for the player). When the camera comes back to focus the table, a null (2311) game object that looks like a bar stool but has no name or examine option is shown in the client where Iffie (11245) used to sit. Assumably to make the cutscene transition smooth between these two states without feeling yanky, the camera had to zoom onto the cook to replace Iffie and the stool behind the scenes. This varbit hack most likely exists for the execution. ==Changes south of the Edgeville Monastery== Set to 2 when the player enters the instance for the cinematic action scene where the player and Iffie (11240) both are climbing trees to scare Oziach (11241). ===Unique bottle destroy dialogue=== If the player destroys Jered's empty wine bottle, in the first instance (0) the player doesn't say Oops, I shouldn't have destroyed the bottle. In the second instance (2), the player does say that. ===Random overhead dialogue theory=== Oziach (11241) talks in the second instance (2), but he stays silent in the first instance (0). Thanks to developer knowledge of poisons, a theory can be derived. When cows are spawned, a script poisons them with a special cow poison effect, which gives them their random overhead dialogue. This is why cows are also poison and venom immune. Similarly, it can be derived that Oziach (11241) can be poisoned with a special Oziach poison effect when Oziach (11241) is spawned, and can be cured of this poison when needed for cutscenes. He can be rarely seen saying a random overhead dialogue (such as ) when the next cutscene starts where an Estate agent (11242) arrives. One game cycle after the cutscene has started, Oziach (11241), his random overhead dialogue abruptly ends and thus it can be derived he can be cured of his Oziach poison effect. After a short pause, his scripted overhead dialogue for the cutscene starts (which may be another or several different scripted poisons). In the overworld, two Oziach NPCs exist with unique IDs: Oziach (11236) and Oziach (11237), both with seperate unconditional overheads. Because everything in the overworld affects all players, RS:Varbit/13102 multiviews are then used per-player to hide or display an Oziach NPC. This cinematic hack varbit (13104) is not related to those two NPCs. Theory: When Oziach (11241) is spawned into the instance or cutscene, the server script checks if this varbit's value is 2. If so, Oziach (11241) is poisoned with his special Oziach poison to enable random overheads. Cutscene / dialogue scripts may cure him of his poison or replace his poisons as needed. ===False leads and other theories=== Five more Evergreen (2091) trees have been replaced with Evergreen (42873). However in the overworld because they use the common object ID (2091), and leaving the instance does not reset this value. The instance has been hand-crafted specifically to include six Evergreen (42873) trees. Another theory can be considered that Iffie (11240) would change her dialogue based on if she's in the instance or not, because Iffie both inside and outside the instance share the same NPC ID. However, leaving the instance does not reset this value, and Iffie (11240) seems to be aware if she's in an instance or not in some other way (likely based on location). Iffie is able to complain about the player leaving cutscenes and instances at the Blue Moon Inn without using this varbit, and so her complaint dialogue seems to be tied to RS:Varbit/13097 or some other scripted triggers. ==Values== ; 0 : Iffie (11240) (with a stool in her 3D model) is in the cutscene. The stool game object (2311) is not present. ; 1 : Iffie (11245) is in the cutscene. The stool game object (2311) is present. ; 2 : Uncertain, but associated with many plausibilities. See above. ==Trivia== * Outside of the cutscene in the overworld, there are two bar stools where the player and Iffie (would) sit, both with unique IDs: Bar stool (42868) for the player, and Bar stool (42887) for Iffie. The rest are regular bar stools, such as 2311.

description: Associated with the multiviews of the table objects at the back of the Blue Moon Inn, located in the kitchen. This allows those tables with kitchen utensils on them to be replaced with empty low tables, depending on the player's 2021 Halloween event progression. This varbit has no effect on the kitchen cutscene. ==Values== ; 0 : The default value, which it is also before the 2021 Halloween event has been started and before Iffie has stolen the kitchen supplies from the Blue Moon Inn. : Table (42869) is not viewed. Table (42871) is viewed. : Table (42870) is not viewed. Table (42872) is viewed. ; 1 : Set when the kitchen cutscene featuring an angry Cook (11251) at the Blue Moon Inn finishes to the end, as soon as the player continues on the following dialogue: Iffie: No, I don't like pumpkin! Iffie has stolen the kitchen supplies. : Table (42869) is viewed. Table (42871) is not viewed. : Table (42870) is viewed. Table (42872) is not viewed. ==Examine texts== ; Table (42869) : A low table. ; Table (42870) : A low table. ; Table (42871) : A low table with a rolling pin on it. ; Table (42872) : A low table with a saucepan on it. ==Trivia== * In the kitchen cutscene, the client does not receive modifications to this varbit's value to change the tables. The changes to the tables in the cutscene are done server-side to the instance. * Iffie steals the kitchen supplies individually in the cutscene, so more than one bit of information would be needed to convey the information to the client with a varbit during the cutscene. * It's difficult to reason why the developers didn't choose to reuse the Table (2333) game object, instead of introducing two new nearly identical copies of it with the 2021 Halloween update. Perhaps at one point during development there was an intention of being able to return the stolen utensils back to the cook, although this is not seen in the game in its current state. Alternatively, engine work.

name: hw21_caught
description: In the 2021 Halloween event, in the instances where the player is attempting to scare Oziach (11241) either alone or with Iffie (2021 Halloween event) (11240), this varbit's value is switched permanently to 1 immediately if Oziach (11241) says . Effectively Oziach (11237) will then remember to have seen the player hiding by the tree. There are two ways for the player to be caught by Oziach (11241): * The player moves closer to Oziach (11241) in his line of sight, next to the tree or past it. * The player waits without climbing the tree within 50 game cycles (30.00 seconds). The timer starts in the first instance when the following dialogue is seen: Player: I just need to climb this tree and blow on the bottle, that should do it. In the second instance, the timer starts sometime after the player can move their player character. The player's dialogue has somewhat higher priority than Oziach's (11241) which has a low/normal priority queue; this means Oziach (11241) won't exclaim his attention nor close the player's chat dialogue interface even if the timer reaches 50 game cycles before the player's higher priority interfaces are closed. After the player's higher priority interfaces are closed and 50 game cycles have passed since the timer started, Oziach exclaims his attention immediately and the player gets caught. Leaving the instance early by logging out, issuing a movement click before starting the timer, or destroying the bottle in the instance, do not affect this varbit's value. Being caught unlocks additional random dialogue with Oziach (11237), after "scaring" Oziach (11241) the first time (one ghost). ==Values== ; 0 : Oziach (11241) has not spotted the player in the instance. : Oziach's (11237) additional random dialogue is unavailable. ; 1 : Oziach (11241) has spotted the player in the instance. : Oziach's (11237) additional random dialogue is available. ==See also== * Transcript:Oziach (2021 Halloween event) ==Trivia== * Any attempt to "climb" the evergreen trees will stop the timer, even if the trees are too far down the path or on Iffie's side. This will also turn Oziach (11241) blind: Oziach (11241) won't react to the player anymore, even if the player stands in front of him.
